title: GIS Product Engineer II – ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps
descriptionHtml:
Overview

Bring your enthusiasm and talents to Esri, creating industry leading ArcGIS products. The ArcGIS Maps SDKs allow developers to build modern mapping applications for mobile and desktop platforms, with 2D and 3D data visualisation, and online or offline access. This is a fantastic opportunity to join the product development team and support the delivery of regular, high-quality releases in a collaborative and dynamic environment.  

Help us improve our cross-platform GIS software libraries, built on the latest compilers and C++ standards, and create sample apps, developer documentation, and developer outreach.  

Esri has a Relocation Assistance Program and can provide support with relocating to the Cardiff area for this position. Check out more details of the Esri R&D Center – Cardiff!

Responsibilities

  • Apply curious, independent thought, and attention to detail to explore and understand the challenges that ArcGIS users face and provide usable, informative feedback on user experience
  • Understand the customer, who are software developers, gathering requirements and use cases that translate into actionable code and doc improvements 
  • Build rich and varied GIS datasets and maps, sample applications and articles that can be used to highlight product capabilities, explain APIs and guide user (developer) practices
  • Work with your development team, and teams across Esri, to design, create, and validate the newest datasets and GIS workflows to support field mapping, data collection, spatial analysis and verify the functionality meets user workflows and is consistent with Esri ecosystem
  • Describe GIS best practices and demonstrate how to apply these GIS workflows in internal team meetings, on product forums and websites, with customers, at Esri events, or in publications like the ArcGIS Blog
  • Document technical topics and concepts, and produce developer-focused product documentation
  • Learn about and collaborate in SDK environments (such as Kotlin, Qt, C#, Swift, Flutter, Python), to explore issues, investigate problems, and design and prototype enhancements 
  • Build focused test code to represent complex situations for investigation and regression testing
  • Administer, automate, and manage online and database GIS systems and services to support the development of new product features and ongoing product releases

Requirements

  • 2+ years of GIS experience (such as modeling, analyzing, or presenting geospatial data in a scientific, engineering, governmental, or post graduate academic environment)
  • Proficiency with mapping, spatial data or GIS platforms such as ArcGIS or QGIS 
  • Strong problem-solving and analytic skills
  • Proven initiative and creativity to find ways to explore, investigate, test and validate software behavior
  • Excellent communication and team collaboration skills 
  • Experience of, and interest in, scripting or coding to appreciate our developer users' challenges and to communicate effectively with the development team
  • Bachelor’s degree in GIS, geography, computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Existing work authorisation for the United Kingdom

Recommended Qualifications

  • Experience and passion for working with cartography, mapping or geospatial data 
  • Interest in or knowledge of layout, typography, and fonts for international text
  • Proven experience of user communication and education such as having been responsible for product documentation, blogs, written or video tutorials, presentations
  • Familiarity using version control systems such as Git, for documentation and code 
  • Familiarity with some of the scripting or coding languages which our SDKs target, and which we use for automation, such as using Kotlin, Qt, .Net, Swift, Flutter, Typescript or Python
  • Master’s degree in GIS, computer science, engineering, or related field 

Base salary is one component of our total rewards strategy. Compensation decisions and the base range for this role take into account many factors including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

title: Global Sourcing Manager Sensors & Optics
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Global Sourcing Manager Sensors & Optics, you own the supply chain strategy and sourcing for Harmattan AI’s optical assemblies and advanced sensor technologies. You are the first hire in this specialized area, working side by side with Engineering, Product, Program and Production. You secure the parts, materials and manufacturing services that are critical to our systems, balancing cost, reliability and quality as we scale.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the global sourcing strategy for optical and sensor technologies.

  • Source specialized components, materials and manufacturing services for optical assemblies and sensor subsystems.

  • Build and manage a strategic supplier network across emerging and established product lines.

  • Vet vendor technical capabilities alongside engineering teams, covering performance, quality systems and production readiness.

  • Negotiate and structure robust commercial terms that optimize unit economics and protect supply continuity.

  • Identify and de-risk supply chain exposure across a complex, rapidly scaling electronics supply chain.

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Program and Production to align sourcing decisions with design and delivery priorities.

  • Own supplier performance on cost, lead time and quality, and travel to supplier sites as needed.

Candidate Requirements

  • Master’s degree in Purchasing, Supply Chain or a related field.

  • 5 to 8 years of experience sourcing optical, imaging or sensor technologies, ideally in defense, aerospace or other high-reliability industries.

  • Strong technical understanding of sensors and optical assemblies, enough to challenge suppliers and engineers on feasibility and quality.

  • Proven commercial skills in negotiating contracts and managing supplier relationships.

  • Full ownership mindset, with the ability to build a function from scratch in a fast-paced environment.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to supplier sites.

  • Full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision and growth plans, with a willingness to go the extra mile.

  • Fluency in French and English required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Growth Associate
descriptionHtml:

  • You want to roll up your sleeves: you know most of the work required to grow a company is not glamorous, and you deeply care to do a great job on every sub-component required to get to the result

Why Encord

title: Head of India
descriptionHtml:
The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.

You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.

As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.

Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

  • Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

  • Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

  • The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

  • Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

  • The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

  • The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

Who You Are

  • 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.

  • Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.

  • Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.

  • A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.

  • A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.

Why This Role

India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

 

Taptap Values

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

 

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Head of Recruiting / Recruiting Lead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer sind wir

Teaching Socials ist die führende Unternehmensberatung für Personal Brands im Finanz- & Immobilienbereich im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 30 High-Performern ist innerhalb von 2 Jahren von 0 auf 1 Mio. € Monatsumsatz gewachsen. Wir verbinden Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum in einem System. Unser weiteres Wachstum hängt an einer Frage: Holen wir die richtigen Menschen schnell genug an Bord? Genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Was für dich drin ist

  • Du führst die gesamte Recruiting-Abteilung und machst sie zum Wachstumsmotor des Unternehmens
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Ein Datenpartner an deiner Seite: Unser Sales & HR Analyst liefert die Zahlen, du entscheidest, was daraus folgt
  • Direkter Impact: Jeder starke Hire in Sales und Account Management bewegt unseren Umsatz sichtbar
  • Verdienst ab 75.000 € p. a. plus leistungsbasiertem Bonus
  • Remote möglich, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz im Office in Hockenheim
  • Investition in dein Skill-Development und 4 Team Events pro Jahr

So sieht dein Job bei uns aus

Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für unsere Recruiting-Abteilung. Du führst das bestehende Team und baust Prozesse, Standards und SOPs auf. Für unsere Key-Hires in Sales und Account Management trägst du die volle Verantwortung, vom Erstkontakt bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag. Die besten Kandidaten suchen meist gar nicht, deshalb gehst du über Active Sourcing und Direktansprache selbst auf sie zu.

Du steuerst den gesamten Funnel: Kennenlerngespräch, Bewerbungsgespräch, Probetag, Referenzcheck und Angebot. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst du die Rollenarchitektur, also Scorecards, Stellen-VSLs, Landingpages und Recruiting-Ads. Du legst fest, was im Recruiting gemessen wird, und setzt das Dashboard in Close und Recruitee so auf, dass es echte Entscheidungen ermöglicht. Mit unserem Sales & HR Analyst wertest du die Zahlen aus, erkennst Engpässe und passt Prozesse an.

Deine Recruiter führst und coachst du, und mit Call-Reviews sicherst du die Qualität ihrer Arbeit. Neue Hires übergibst du sauber an die Teamleads und ins Onboarding. Was die Probezeit zeigt, fließt bei dir zurück in den Auswahlprozess. Wenn es zählt, bist du vor Ort: bei Probetagen, Starttagen und Quarterly Meetings.

Gemessen wirst du nicht an Aktivität, sondern an Ergebnissen:

  • Time-to-Hire pro Rolle
  • Conversion zwischen den Funnel-Stufen
  • Anzahl qualifizierter Kandidaten bis zur Besetzung
  • Offer-Acceptance-Rate
  • Pipeline-Abdeckung für unsere Key-Rollen
  • Wer von deinen Hires die Probezeit besteht und nach 90 Tagen performt
  • Performance deines Teams

Nach 90 Tagen erwarten wir ein Recruiting-Dashboard, dem die Geschäftsführung vertraut, einen dokumentierten Funnel mit SOPs und die ersten Key-Hires in Sales oder Account Management.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Recruiting oder Talent Acquisition, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer führenden Rolle, etwa als Teamlead, Head of oder Recruiting Lead
  • Eigener Sales-Background: Du warst selbst im Closing, im Setting oder als Sales Lead aktiv. Du weißt, wie Vertriebler ticken, weil du einer bist
  • Nachweislich besetzte Sales- und Account-Management-Rollen im B2B-High-Ticket-Umfeld, etwa in Agentur, Beratung, Coaching oder Online-Business
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-System mit Funnel, Prozessen, Scorecards und Tracking aufgebaut und nicht nur darin gearbeitet
  • Echte KPI-Verantwortung: Du kennst deine Zahlen zu Time-to-Hire, Funnel-Conversion, Kandidaten pro Besetzung und Probezeit-Erfolg
  • Du hast ein Recruiting-Team aufgebaut, geführt und auf Performance gebracht, auch wenn es ein kleines war
  • Hunter-Gen: Du findest die besten Kandidaten über Active Sourcing, Direktansprache und Netzwerke, auch wenn sie gar nicht suchen
  • Treffsicheres Profiling: Du erkennst früh, ob jemand im High-Ticket-Sales liefern wird, und lässt dich von guter Selbstdarstellung nicht blenden
  • Ownership: Wenn zwei Wochen lang kein Bewerbungsgespräch zustande kommt, merkst du es selbst, findest die Ursache und handelst, bevor jemand fragt
  • Sehr starke Kommunikation: Du verkaufst unsere Vision ehrlich, selektiv und auf Augenhöhe mit A-Playern
  • Pluspunkte:
    • Du warst selbst Head of Sales, Sales Lead oder selbstständig im Vertrieb bzw. im Headhunting
    • Du hast ein Netzwerk in der Closer- und Agentur-Szene im DACH-Raum
    • Du hast hohes Hiring-Volumen mit mehreren parallel offenen Rollen gestemmt
    • Du hast Erfahrung mit Scorecards, Probetagen, Case Studies und Referenzchecks
    • Du kennst Close, Recruitee oder vergleichbare CRM- und ATS-Systeme samt Recruiting-Dashboards

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du HR-Generalist bist und vor allem Personalverwaltung, Verträge, Payroll und Feel-Good machst. Das ist eine Recruiting-Rolle, keine HR-Rolle
  • du bisher nur Stellen gepostet und Kennenlerngespräche geführt hast, ohne je ein System, ein Team oder Zahlen zu verantworten
  • du nie selbst verkauft hast und Vertriebler nur von außen kennst
  • du ein fertiges Setup, große Budgets und lange Freigabeschleifen brauchst, um zu liefern
  • du dich hervorragend präsentieren, aber nicht mit konkreten Zahlen belegen kannst, was du tatsächlich besetzt hast
  • Remote für dich Freiheit von Verbindlichkeit bedeutet
  • du lieber als externer Freelancer auf Projektbasis arbeitest, statt Teil des Teams zu sein
  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht wachsen willst

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich bei uns und werde Teil unseres Teams.

Nice to have: multi-country IT experience (ideally in high-growth or emerging markets); networking fundamentals (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, ISPs) and contact-centre telephony; vendor management; applying LLMs or agentic workflows to internal operations; relevant certifications. Probably not a fit if your experience is mainly managing vendors and tickets rather than building.

Our Mission 🌍

We create financial inclusion for the traditionally excluded through a fair, flexible, customer-centric financing model. We strive to drive greater inclusion of women, youth and low-income communities.

Ready to build the systems that keep a pan-African fintech running, while advancing your career in IT engineering? Apply now!

Why M-KOPA?

Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com.

  • Évaluer la performance et le comportement du produit selon les configurations et cas d'usage cliniques.

  • Planifier, concevoir et exécuter les activités d'intégration et validation du logiciel d'imagerie médicale selon IEC 62304 et exigences réglementaires.

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
descriptionHtml:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Assignment

The assignment will include the following tasks:

  • A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.

  • A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.

  • Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.

  • Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.

Results

The final outcomes of this assignment will be:

§ A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case.

§ An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm.

§ A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work.

Duration

For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months.

Profile

  • You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master.

  • You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus.

  • You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn.

  • You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice.

What we offer

  • A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment

  • Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support

  • An internship allowance

  • Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team

  • Internship results to be used in the current and future projects

About NLR

Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ervaren IT-specialisten aan projecten op het gebied van infrastructuur, werkplekbeheer en procesverbetering. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie.

Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand.

Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, servicegericht en krijgt energie van het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt graag samen met anderen en bent niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ben je flexibel en betrouwbaar. Idealiter herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je volgt momenteel een mbo-opleiding richting ICT, Informatica, Systeem- en Netwerkbeheer of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met IT-support en systeembeheer;

  • Je bent leergierig en wilt graag praktijkervaring opdoen binnen een professionele IT-omgeving;

  • Je beschikt over basiskennis van Windows, Microsoft 365 en netwerken;

  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken;

  • Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed.

Wat bieden wij?

Een unieke kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een snelgroeiende, internationale organisatie. Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid staan centraal binnen onze bedrijfscultuur.

Wij bieden:

  • Een uitdagende stage binnen een internationale organisatie;

  • Begeleiding door ervaren IT-professionals;

  • Veel ruimte om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Werken met moderne technologieën en professionele IT-omgevingen;

  • Een stagevergoeding van €525 per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Een prachtig kantoor in het centrum van Rotterdam, met uitzicht op de Maas en de Erasmusbrug.

title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) - Microsoft 365 & Hybrid IT
descriptionHtml:
Über die Prokuras Gruppe

Prokuras ist eine deutschlandweit agierende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich des Immobilien- und Gebäudemanagements. Bundesweit gehören inzwischen mehr als 500 Mitarbeitende zu den Unternehmen der Prokuras Gruppe. Seit Gründung im Jahr 2023 sind wir durch die Umsetzung von Nachfolgesituationen und Wachstumspartnerschaften stetig gewachsen.
Als in Hamburg ansässige Holding-Gesellschaft unterstützen wir unsere Unternehmer und Mitarbeitenden bei der Bewältigung ihrer alltäglichen großen wie kleinen Herausforderungen.
Um das Wachstum unserer Unternehmensgruppe gezielt zu steuern und weiter voranzutreiben, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – hybride IT-Landschaft aus Microsoft 365, Cloud-Diensten und lokalen Systemen für unseren Standort in Kassel.

Wir suchen keine reine Support-Rolle, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Themen eigenständig vorantreibt und aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Landschaft mitwirkt.

Funktion und Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Microsoft 365 Administration: Eigenverantwortliche Administration, Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung.
  • Identity & Access Management: Verwaltung von Benutzerkonten, Gruppen, Rollen und Berechtigungen in Microsoft Entra ID sowie Microsoft 365.
  • Active Directory & Hybrid IT: Betreuung von Active Directory-Umgebungen sowie Unterstützung bei der Integration und Verwaltung lokaler Systeme und Anwendungen.
  • Microsoft-Plattformen: Administration und Support für Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive und weitere Microsoft-365-Dienste.
  • IT-Support: Unterstützung im First- und Second-Level-Support für unsere Partnergesellschaften und Mitarbeitenden bei technischen Fragestellungen.
  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Einrichtung und Verwaltung von Benutzerkonten, Endgeräten, Postfächern, Berechtigungen und Zugängen.
  • IT-Projekte & Digitalisierung: Mitarbeit bei gruppenweiten IT-Projekten, der Einführung neuer Technologien sowie der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Arbeitsprozesse.
  • Störungsanalyse & Problemlösung: Selbstständige Analyse, Priorisierung und nachhaltige Behebung technischer Probleme.
  • Dokumentation & Standards: Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentationen sowie Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung einheitlicher IT-Standards innerhalb der Gruppe.
  • Ansprechpartner für Kolleginnen und Kollegen: Verständliche Vermittlung technischer Themen und Unterstützung im Arbeitsalltag.

Kompetenzen und Erfahrungen

  • Ausbildung oder Studium: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug.
  • Microsoft-365-Kenntnisse: Fundierte praktische Erfahrungen in der Administration von Microsoft 365 und den dazugehörigen Administrationsportalen.
  • Active Directory: Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Active Directory sowie idealerweise Kenntnisse hybrider Microsoft-Umgebungen.
  • IT-Infrastruktur: Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Benutzerverwaltung, Windows-Systeme, Netzwerke und IT-Support.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben gleichzeitig den Überblick.
  • Problemlösungskompetenz: Du analysierst technische Herausforderungen systematisch und findest pragmatische sowie nachhaltige Lösungen.
  • Kommunikation: Du kannst technische Sachverhalte verständlich erklären und arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichsten Ansprechpartnern zusammen.
  • Dokumentation: Sorgfältige und nachvollziehbare Dokumentation deiner Arbeit ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Interesse an neuen Technologien sowie die Bereitschaft, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Copilot & KI: Interesse an modernen KI-Lösungen und idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit Microsoft Copilot oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen.

Leistungen und Benefits

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Wir setzen auf Vertrauen statt starrer Vorgaben. Homeoffice ist bei uns selbstverständlich. Gleichzeitig ist uns der persönliche Austausch wichtig, weshalb wir uns auf mindestens zwei gemeinsame Bürotage pro Woche freuen.
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Freue dich auf ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, das deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht, und werde Teil einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe mit langfristiger Perspektive.
  • Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag: Bei uns übernimmst du früh Verantwortung und kannst aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Landschaft mitwirken.
  • Weiterbildung & Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Moderne Technologien: Arbeite mit Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot und modernen Cloud-Lösungen in einem dynamischen Unternehmensumfeld.
  • Top Teamkultur & Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite in einem modernen, kollegialen Umfeld, das dich in deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung unterstützt.
  • Attraktive betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Über eine Direktversicherung steuerlich gefördert für die Zukunft vorsorgen.
  • Exklusive Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Profitiere von zahlreichen Vergünstigungen und attraktiven Angeboten über unseren Partner ValueNet.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam die IT-Landschaft der Prokuras Gruppe weiterzuentwickeln. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!

CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE

  • Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control.

  • Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏢 Large Enterprise sales: You have at least five years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, selling into organisations with 5,001 or more employees, and you can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length.

  • 💰 Six-figure deals: You have closed multiple deals of £100k+ ACV in multi-stakeholder cycles of three to six months or more.

  • 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than relying on expansion or inbound.

  • 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years.

  • 🧭 Structured selling: You use a methodology such as MEDDPICC and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews.

  • 📍 Location: You are based in Germany or Austria. We sponsor visas for Germany; if you are based in Austria or in another country, you need the existing right to work there. This role covers the DACH territory and involves regular travel to customers in the region.

  • 🗣️ Languages: You are fluent in English and German, as you will sell to customers across DACH.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms.

  • 🤝 Partner-led deals: You have worked deals with system integrators or cloud partners.

  • 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue.

Why join us?

You will close the largest deals in our portfolio and shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest organisations, with a product technical teams already use and love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships, Customer Success and Product, and leadership will listen to what you learn in the field. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the global enterprise.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

title: Lead Acquisition B2C
descriptionHtml:
Green-Got en bref

Green-Got est une alternative complète et moderne aux grandes banques, du paiement à l'investissement.

En finance, on ne construit pas à côté du système. Nous y prenons du pouvoir pour en changer la direction.

  • Ce que nous refusons : nous excluons strictement l'expansion fossile, sur tous nos produits. Et notre assurance-vie et notre PER, c'est zéro financement d'entreprise dans le pesticide.

  • Ce que nous dévoilons : ce que les banques traditionnelles font de l'argent de leurs clients. Et nous sommes transparents jusque sur nos propres limites.

  • Ce que nous construisons : les paiements de nos membres financent des enquêtes, du lobbying et du plaidoyer qui s'attaquent aux causes. Les banques ont des lobbyistes ; nos membres en ont un aussi.

Quelques repères :

  • Plus de 3 milliards d'euros déjà passés par les comptes et les cartes de nos membres

  • 150 M€ d'épargne sous gestion

  • 15 millions d'euros levés auprès de notre communauté, à chaque fois en un temps record

Pourquoi ce poste compte autant. Chaque compte ouvert envoie un message aux grandes banques : le marché a changé. Et plus nous grandissons, plus nous pesons. Notre ambition est assumée : devenir un actionnaire qui pèse au conseil des entreprises qui freinent la transition. Nous commencerons une fois le cap du milliard d'euros d'épargne franchi. Entre nos 150 M€ et ce milliard, il y a ton travail.

Le poste

Tu prends en main toute l'acquisition B2C haut de funnel de Green-Got : faire venir de nouvelles personnes sur notre app, et les amener à ouvrir un compte ou à investir.

Tu as deux grands objectifs : les ouvertures de compte (compte + carte de paiement) et la collecte (investissement). Notre north star, c'est l'ARR : ce qui compte, c'est ce que tu rapportes vraiment à la boîte, pas le nombre de clics.

Tu ne pars pas de zéro. Nos canaux existent et tournent déjà. Ton job : les reprendre, les améliorer, les scaler, et en inventer de nouveaux. Le budget que tu pilotes se compte en centaines de milliers d'euros.

On cherche un doeur, pas un stratège qui délègue. Tu mets les mains dans le cambouis, tu testes, tu shippes, et tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi lancer.

Ce que tu vas faire

  • Site et trafic : tu es autonome sur le site. Landing pages, SEO, GEO, CRO, A/B tests.

  • Acquisition payante : Google Ads, Meta et autres réseaux sociaux. Ciblage, créas, landing, tests, optimisation, toujours pilotés par le chiffre d'affaires final.

  • Affiliation : tu trouves, négocies et pilotes nos partenaires. Tu contrôles ce qu'ils font, tu mesures ce qui marche vraiment et tu arbitres le budget, sans tout miser sur un seul levier.

  • Budget et rentabilité : tu répartis le budget entre les canaux selon ce qu'ils rapportent, et tu le réorientes quand il le faut.

  • Tracking : tu t'assures que tout ce que tu lances est mesuré correctement. Tu peux te faire aider sur la partie technique.

  • Opérations avec l'équipe Wealth Management : tu lances avec elle les opérations sur nos produits d'investissement.

  • Nouveaux leviers : tu imagines et testes des canaux auxquels personne n'a encore pensé.

Une personne, des agents IA

Pendant des années, une règle a joué contre nous : pour rivaliser avec une banque, il fallait ses effectifs, ses agences et ses milliards. Cette règle vient de tomber.

L'intelligence artificielle ne récompense pas la taille. Elle récompense les organisations alignées, rapides et capables de décider. C'est l'asymétrie du renard, et pour la première fois elle joue pour nous : elle nous permet d'avoir dans dix ans l'impact que nous devions avoir dans cent. Pendant ce temps, les quatre grandes banques françaises portent 260 milliards d'euros d'actifs fossiles, et chaque mois que nous perdons est un mois qu'elles gagnent.

C'est pourquoi tu seras une personne autonome, épaulée par un agent IA pour chaque canal (site, GEO, affiliation, ads…). Notre stack est très moderne, car nous n'avons pas d'autre choix que de nous décupler pour peser.

L'équipe autour de toi

Chez Green-Got, l'acquisition est une boucle complète portée par des profils complémentaires :

  1. Awareness : l’équipe qui fait connaître Green-Got au plus grand nombre

  2. Acquisition haut de funnel : toi

  3. CRM et Product Growth : ceux qui transforment et activent les personnes que tu amènes

Tu travailles main dans la main avec le CRM, avec le Product Growth et avec l'équipe Wealth Management.

Tu es rattaché au Head of Growth, qui est là pour te mentorer, t'aider et te guider.
Notre Head of Growth, Clément Jaunault, fait de la growth depuis dix ans, de la legaltech au SaaS. Arrivé chez Green-Got avant le lancement, il l'a fait passer de 0 à 100 000 utilisateurs et de 0 à 300 M€ d'encours, et il mentore déjà de jeunes growth hors de l'entreprise.

Ton profil

Indispensable

title: Lead Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer to own the technical direction of a data engagement, working with AWS data services, platforms like Snowflake and Databricks, Python, and PySpark across our data team. You’ll lead a team of data engineers, setting the standards for how pipelines and architecture are designed, built, and operated, while staying hands-on with the most complex technical challenges. You’ll work closely with client stakeholders and CreateFuture’s wider engineering capability to make sure delivery is both technically excellent and commercially sound.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own the technical direction of a data engagement, setting standards for pipeline architecture, data modelling, orchestration, testing, and operational readiness
  • Lead and technically direct a team of data engineers, allocating work, reviewing designs and code, and unblocking technical challenges
  • Design and evolve data platform architecture on AWS (e.g. AWS Glue, EMR, S3/Lake Formation, Redshift, Athena) alongside platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks, weighing trade-offs in performance, cost, and maintainability
  • Set and enforce CI/CD, testing, observability, and operational practices across the engagement’s data engineering workflows
  • Build professional relationships with key client stakeholders, translating business and data requirements into a coherent technical roadmap, with clear estimates, trade-offs, and risks
  • Troubleshoot and resolve the most complex issues in live data pipelines, and lead incident response when things go wron

We'd love to talk to you if you:

  • Have extensive hands-on experience designing and operating production data platforms on a modern cloud data stack such as AWS (Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3/Lake Formation), Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable, and can articulate which architectural decisions travel between platforms and which don’t
  • Have deep SQL expertise and a strong grasp of data modelling and architecture (Kimball, data vault, medallion/lakehouse patterns, or domain modelling). This is the clearest line between someone who operates a platform and someone who can design on top of it, and it’s provider-agnostic
  • Have owned orchestration strategy in production, including dependency design, retries, SLAs, and the observability that tells you a pipeline failed before the client does
  • Have designed ingestion from awkward sources (APIs, CDC off operational databases, files that change shape without warning) and set patterns your team can reuse
  • Have strong proficiency in Python and PySpark for batch/ELT processing at scale, with production-grade, well-tested code. The bulk of this work is batch and ELT, but you’ll have experience with event-driven or micro-batch pipelines and know where the design assumptions stop holding
  • Have led or technically directed a team of data engineers, setting standards for pipeline design, testing, and delivery, and growing the engineers around you
  • Have owned CI/CD and operational practices for data engineering workflows across a team or engagement
  • Are experienced working directly with client stakeholders, building trust, shaping solutions from ambiguous requirements, and challenging where appropriate

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Lead Engineer - Travel FX App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Lead Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

In Faculty’s Applied AI group, we partner with ambitious organisations across private and public sectors to help them reinvent how they work, compete and serve people with AI. We bring them our extensive expertise in using AI in real-world situations and a track record of delivering serious impact.

Product managers in Applied AI provide strategic leadership for Faculty’s clients, guiding stakeholders through discovery, decision-making and execution. We help our clients to achieve the greatest impact for their organisations with the very latest AI advancements and we teach bleeding-edge product development practices.

As a Lead Product Manager at Faculty, you’ll take on large strategic client engagements, leading teams that include top-flight Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Product Designers, among others. You’ll help to drive the strategic direction of high-impact AI products for our clients, balancing complex technical considerations and user needs to achieve real commercial outcomes.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and shipping impactful products that realise the potential of frontier AI.

  • Acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders at big-name clients on their product and AI strategies.

  • Leading discovery to identify the right problems to solve, using clear hypotheses and success measures to decide what gets built.

  • Keeping teams focused on outcomes, not just outputs by defining clear goals, shaping prioritisation and articulating trade-offs.

  • Embedding innovation culture among our clients, guiding and inspiring them.

  • Collaborating with your cross-functional teammates including Data Scientists, Engineers, Product Designers and Delivery to set the quality bar for AI products, including the eval strategy to ensure they continue to work as intended.

  • Building lasting product development capability in client organisations, from the habits of individual teams to the product operating model as a whole.

  • Advising clients on how AI can accelerate and improve their product development lifecycle, from research and discovery through to delivery and measurement.

  • Contributing to Faculty's product practice through developing case studies, thought leadership and repeatable methods that scale across clients.

  • Partnering with Delivery leads on planning and execution, including supporting business development and fostering strong client relationships.

  • Coaching and developing other product managers.

Who we're looking for:

  • You have substantial experience conceiving, building and launching products at scale, including at least 2 years in a product leadership role.

  • You’ve routinely worked directly with C-suite or equivalent senior leaders at significant, successful organisations.

  • Exceptional commercial acumen: you've made the case for new products or services - whether for revenue, savings or public benefit - and defended it with senior budget holders.

  • You relish unstructured problems and can turn them into clear plans that teams can execute.

  • You can comfortably converse with experts in how AI models are created, evaluated and operationalised.

  • You have demonstrable experience in rolling out cutting-edge AI-accelerated product development processes.

  • You have a clear track record of mentoring team members and fostering a collaborative, ambitious culture.

  • You show forward-thinking initiative to spot new client opportunities, solve ambiguous problems, and build enduring organisational value.

Desirable experience

  • You have meaningful professional services or consulting experience, ideally with large enterprises.

  • You’ve held a product leadership position in at least one scaled-up, fast-moving product-led organisation, owning significant scope and achieving meaningful impact.

  • You're an active voice in the product community, speaking at conferences or contributing to panels and publications.

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

title: Lead Software Engineer (Hybrid)
descriptionHtml:
Lead Engineer

Location: Waterloo, London, England, UK | Hybrid (1 day per week in office)

Who We Are 

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.

Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.

If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.

Who You Are

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 7+ years. You can be the go-to leader for any software development engagement. You have a broad and deep range of expertise that allows you to make an immediate impact on projects. In your previous experience, you have:

  • Successfully led high-stakes consulting engagements from discovery to production 
  • Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served 
  • Written production-quality code using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Rust, Scala, R, and SQL
  • Leveraged AI-assistive development tools for tasks like scaffolding, refactoring, debugging, test generation, and documentation
  • Experience building or integrating AI/ML-powered features into products or systems (e.g., recommendation engines, NLP models, computer vision, predictive analytics) 
  • Used context-appropriate automated testing to inform software design choices and catch bugs
  • Debugged and refactored pre-existing code to incrementally improve it
  • Collaborated with teams using Git, MacOS/Linux, and CI/CD
  • Remedied architecture-level concerns such as scalability, security, reliability, and performance
  • Brought together people from different functions and perspectives in forums that encourage idea sharing, collaboration, and problem solving
  • Made thoughtful recommendations and set direction in the face of ambiguity
  • Mentored and shared knowledge with colleagues
  • Actively sought out and effectively given feedback
  • Communicated empathically with stakeholders and colleagues
  • Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs

What You’ll Do At 8th Light

As a lead technologist on projects, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, through a variety of technologies and frameworks over the course of your career with us. You’ll lead more complicated projects, leading teams to do so. You’ll work with colleagues who share your passion for technology solutions. You’ll invest time developing your skills and sharing what you know. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Making immediate contributions to projects, rapidly building trust with clients
  • Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
  • Leading architecture and software design discussions
  • Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
  • Generating new potential solutions to challenges (technical and non-technical) in partnership with team members and clients
  • Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
  • Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
  • Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
  • Ensuring your team has a healthy, prioritized, estimated backlog
  • Managing high-level project roadmaps as the team lead for large engagements
  • Maintaining relationships with client technical leaders
  • Regular syncs with the client to provide status updates, and for identifying and evaluating risks and presenting potential solutions
  • Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
  • Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes

Strongly Preferred Skills

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:

  • Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
  • Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
  • Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
  • DevSecOps & DevOps
  • MLOps
  • Infrastructure as Code

Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences. 

How You’ll be Supported

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future. 

  • Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
  • A robust L&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
  • Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development
  • Coworking support for our global team
  • 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits. 

A Note on Compensation

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Lead Engineer position within London is: £76,023-95,029 GBP. 

Reach out to ----- for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.

8th Light Hubs and Geographies

8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle. 

  • London Co-working: Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.

We hope to see you apply!

A Note on Your Privacy

At 8th Light, one of our core values is Honesty that builds trust — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of who we are, what we're looking for, and how we handle your information throughout the process.

Before submitting your application, please take a moment to review our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying, you acknowledge that you've read it.

title: Legal Engineer, Product Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey’s Legal Engineer - Product Specialists are experienced lawyers from top-tier firms who leverage their legal expertise to help customers seamlessly integrate Harvey into their daily workflows—driving adoption, increasing utilization, and supporting long-term expansion and renewal. Legal Engineer - Product Specialists collaborate closely with Harvey’s Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to drive all facets of the post-sales strategy. They develop consultative relationships with law firm partners, associates, innovation teams, and in-house counsel at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies—serving as trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can enhance legal effectiveness and efficiency.

Legal Engineer - Product Specialists draw on their legal training and practice experience to ask thoughtful questions, uncover adoption barriers, and develop tailored strategies that build credibility with customers. They partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to communicate Harvey’s value through a mix of large group sessions, small workshops, and one-on-one conversations.

What You’ll Do

  • Build trusted relationships with law firm and in-house legal teams by understanding their unique workflows and offering tailored guidance on how to incorporate Harvey’s AI into their daily practice.

  • Design and lead onboarding sessions, training workshops, and ongoing enablement programs that drive adoption and maximize the value of Harvey’s platform.

  • Act as a strategic partner to Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to identify expansion opportunities and support renewal efforts through demonstrated impact and engagement.

  • Proactively surface obstacles to adoption by engaging users with thoughtful questions and legal empathy, then develop and implement strategies to overcome them.

  • Translate legal practice needs into actionable feedback for the product and engineering teams, helping to shape product development through a lawyer’s lens.

  • Monitor usage trends and identify at-risk accounts or untapped opportunities, working cross-functionally to re-engage users and showcase new or underutilized capabilities.

  • Contribute to customer-facing content (e.g., training materials, use case guides, FAQ resources) to ensure continued customer success across a range of practice areas.

  • Support the credibility and brand of Harvey as the leading AI platform for lawyers by delivering high-quality, domain-specific guidance that meets the expectations of top-tier legal professionals.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.

What You Have

  • JD or equivalent legal qualification.

  • At least 3 years of experience practicing law within at a top in-house team.

  • Executive engagement skills and presence, with an ability to establish strong relationships with key decision makers and build credibility at all levels.

  • Outstanding presentation skills to both legal and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.

  • Strong understanding of legal processes and challenges faced by legal professionals.

  • Curiosity about AI’s potential to transform the legal industry.

  • Sales or customer-facing experience, including law firm business development and/or secondment, is a plus, as is experience directly managing law firm client matters and client relationships.

title: LLM Engineer — Post-Training (Remote - Netherlands)
descriptionHtml:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

60 Million Users in 3 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 60 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most LLM roles stop at experimentation.

Here, the models you improve power experiences for 50M+ users.

Most of our traffic runs on self-hosted, fine-tuned open-weight models. On our internal roleplay evals, our smaller fine-tuned models can outperform much larger off-the-shelf models. Your job is to make them better.

You’ll join a small AI team led by Marco, our LLM Tech Lead, working closely with our CTO, Product, Web and DevOps teams. You’ll work across data, post-training, evals, and model behavior, taking ideas from failure analysis to production.

The problems are real: personalization, character consistency, long conversations, better evals, multilingual behavior, and faster training cycles.

If you want to shape model behavior at consumer scale, this is the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Fine-tune open-weight LLMs using SFT, LoRA/QLoRA and post-training methods such as DPO and GRPO

  • Diagnose model failures and turn them into experiments. Decide whether the answer is better data, post-training, prompting or classifiers

  • Build training data and evals that directly shape what gets trained next

  • Improve model behavior across personalization, consistency, tone, multilingual and group interactions

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

Your Qualifications

  • You’ve personally post-trained open-weight LLMs for a user-facing product and shipped them to production

  • You’ve worked where AI was core to the product or business, not an experimental side feature

  • Fine-tuning is core to your experience

  • Strong Python, PyTorch and Hugging Face, with hands-on GPU training and debugging

  • You build data and evals yourself and make decisions from evidence

  • You can take work beyond notebooks into production

  • You use AI tools daily in your own engineering work

  • You are fully comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit NSFW content, including harmful material when developing and evaluating moderation system

Bonus points

  • Experience with conversational AI, roleplay products, or highly personalized consumer AI

  • Multilingual LLMs

  • Moderation, safety, or adversarial testing

  • Multimodal models

  • Open-source LLM / post-training contributions

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 60M users in 3 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 20 working days of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
