title: People — Employment and Labor Law  (France)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Employment & Labour Law role 🇫🇷

Alan is growing fast: new health services, new entities, new countries, and a 2027 People agenda with social elections and many individual situations.

Each of these brings legal obligations, and today we rely mostly on external counsel. In Alan's terms, "compliance" means everything we do to follow a mandatory rule that would become a risk if we got it wrong.

The role makes sure Alan's employment practices are legally secure, pragmatic and humane. You will be our in-house expert on French employment and labour law, for both individual and collective matters. You are a People teammate first, with a strong legal foundation.

Scope

Alan operates in 8 countries.

This role is based in France and covers French employment and labour law.

It works in tandem with the People Compliance owner, who covers the other countries, and with the International Expansion hire for new country openings. Curiosity for other jurisdictions is a plus, but it is not the core of the role.

You will join the People team, work closely with the People Compliance owner, the People lead and the individual situations crew, and be mentored by Alan's Compliance Key Function on how we practise legal topics at Alan.

The People team

The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission.

The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and M&A and International Expansion.

It is a generalist team: everyone shares core missions, including individual situation management and HRBP responsibilities. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: French employment and labour law.

Your missions

On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a diverse range of high-impact topics:

  • Employment law expertise: be the go-to person on French individual and collective employment law, with a strong focus on working time, night work and on-call rules (astreinte, rest periods), where the rules are strict and a creative, well-grounded approach makes a difference.

  • Legal watch: monitor French labour-law changes, flag what matters for Alan, and use AI agents for legal watch and ongoing compliance checks.

  • Obligations register: turn obligations into simple tools and processes, tracked in a register.

  • Health and safety at work.

  • Audits and inspections: support labour inspections, URSSAF audits and the related compliance reporting.

  • Social dialogue: support the People lead in preparing CSE information-consultations, running the 2027 social elections, and drafting and updating company agreements (working time, profit-sharing, agreements for new services).

  • Corporate structure: work through the People impact of Alan's evolving legal entities, such as which entities sit in the UES and what it means for our agreements.

  • New services: bring a risk-based view early to projects with People impact, such as new health services, and help set up processes that protect Alan while keeping the flexibility and autonomy we want Alaners to have.

  • External counsel: write clear briefs, ask sharper questions, reuse existing frameworks and challenge the advice you receive.

  • Beyond France (occasionally): contribute, when needed, to topics in other countries, alongside the People Compliance owner.

  • Raising the team's expertise: share your legal knowledge with the crew and the wider People team.

  • AI and automation: use them to multiply the impact of your work.

Outcomes within your first months in the team

By 2.5 months

  • You have contributed to a live CSE topic (e.g. preparing an information-consultation) and to at least one other live topic (e.g. working-time or on-call policy, an agreement for a new service).

  • You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management.

By 5 months

  • You own CSE information-consultations end to end, and a workstream such as a company agreement, with the crew as a sounding board.

  • You are involved in preparing the 2027 social elections.

  • You handle French individual situations without supervision, including the legal analysis.

  • A first legal-watch automation is running.

  • Crew members and leads come to you as the go-to expert on French employment law.

Is this what you are looking for?

You may be a great fit for this role if:

  • You have a legal background in French employment and social law (e.g. M2 in droit social).

  • You have around 4+ years of hands-on experience applying French employment law, typically in a law firm (ideally international), or you are a lawyer who has already moved into a People role.

  • You master both individual and collective matters.

  • You are excellent in French (negotiation level) and professional in English (our internal processes and documentation are in English).

  • You put context before opinion: you understand how Alan works first, then adapt the playbook instead of applying it as is.

  • You put business value before legal reflex: you start from the outcome and creative options, tell material risk from theoretical risk, and give practical answers. You are comfortable with a scale-up's risk appetite.

  • You have a transversal mindset: a strong anchor in labour law, and real appetite to cover compliance, expansion and other topics.

  • You are autonomous: you take initiative, flag risks early and own your outputs.

  • You are rigorous: your work is precise and your writing is clear and concise.

  • You are curious and coachable: open to feedback, with a clear idea of what you want to learn.

  • You are AI-enthusiastic: you already use AI in your daily work and stay critical of the output.

  • You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations.

Nice-to-have

We are not looking for all of the below. Any one of these can be a strong signal.

  • Hands-on experience with CSE meetings, information-consultations, social elections or company agreements.

  • Experience in the health sector, insurance, a regulated environment or a scale-up.

  • M&A or reorganisation experience.

  • Exposure to other jurisdictions (Belgium, Spain).

Level range

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0 - D level range.

title: People Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
If you've been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision, exciting challenges and the opportunity to make a genuine difference in the world, you've found the right place.

Our Mission 🌎

At Goodstack, our mission is to revolutionize how the world does good. We envision a world where doing good is built into everything we do.

As a fast-growing, AI-native social impact startup, we're building the technology and infrastructure that connects businesses and good causes, making it easier to give, grow and create meaningful impact at scale.

We do this in two ways:

And we're already making a difference:

What We're Building Next 🚀

We're entering an exciting new chapter: evolving beyond software into an AI-native business that delivers meaningful outcomes for businesses and nonprofits worldwide.

By combining AI, automation and human expertise, we're building a future where companies can manage global giving programmes more seamlessly, and nonprofits can access funding faster and more efficiently.

Our ambition is bold, and the challenges are complex. We're looking for curious, ambitious and AI-native thinkers who take ownership, challenge assumptions and use technology creatively to solve meaningful problems.

That's where you come in 🫵

Join us as People Operations Specialist and help us build a People function that’s simple, dependable, and able to scale!

We're looking for someone to join us in building the next chapter of our People function at Goodstack.

Over the past four years, we've grown more than 8x, from 22 to around 200 Goodstackers across multiple countries. It's been an incredible journey, and with that kind of growth comes a whole lot of interesting challenges.

We've built a strong foundation, but there's plenty of opportunity to make the experience of working at Goodstack even better.

We're looking for someone who enjoys People Operations, gets satisfaction from making complicated things simple, and cares just as much about the little details as the bigger picture. Someone who understands good HR practices, takes ownership, asks thoughtful questions and doesn't wait to be told what needs doing.

In this role, you'll have plenty of autonomy, the opportunity to shape how we work, and a close partnership with the Head of People as we continue scaling the function.


✍️ A note from the Head of People:

Hey, future Goodstacker! 👋

I don't expect you to know everything (who does?), but I do expect you to know your HR foundations, bring good judgement, take ownership and stay curious.

As People Operations Specialist, your mission will be:

  • Prepare and quality-check employment contracts, amendments and other documentation, ensuring accuracy and alignment with applicable employment requirements.

Keeping global People operations running smoothly

  • Support right-to-work checks, immigration and sponsorship administration.

  • Apply HR policies and employment best practices consistently, identifying compliance risks and escalating them early.

  • Keep on top of statutory deadlines and employment obligations, working with external specialists when needed.

Making things better as we grow

  • Coordinate the operational delivery of performance reviews, progression and compensation cycles.

  • Maintain People reporting, policies, templates and internal documentation.

  • Use your HR knowledge to identify gaps in our processes and recommend practical improvements.

  • Find opportunities to simplify workflows and use AI and automation to eliminate repetitive work.


What success looks like:

  • Every new Goodstacker has what they need before Day 1 and feels welcomed from the start.

  • Contracts, payroll inputs, employee changes and records are accurate and delivered on time.

  • Our people and managers can count on you for reliable advice, clear answers and helpful support.

  • You apply sound HR judgement, spot risks early and resolve routine matters without constant oversight.

  • Our People processes run smoothly, with fewer manual steps and less time spent chasing admin.

  • You proactively identify opportunities to strengthen compliance, consistency and the employee experience.

  • Ultimately, you're creating the operational reliability that allows us to spend more time improving the experience of working at Goodstack.


This role is a perfect match for you if you have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on People / HR Ops experience, ideally in a growing, international business.

  • A formal qualification in Human Resources Management, People-related degree, CIPD, or an equivalent recognised professional qualification.

  • A solid understanding of UK employment legislation and HR best practices, with the confidence to apply your knowledge to everyday People matters.

  • Experience preparing employment documentation, managing employee lifecycle processes and supporting payroll and benefits administration.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when handling contracts, payroll, employee data and anything where accuracy really matters.

  • Strong organisational skills and follow-through, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

  • Experience with UK HR administration, alongside exposure to international employment or EOR arrangements.

  • Confidence working with People systems, spreadsheets and payroll processes, with a strong understanding of confidentiality and data handling.

  • Sound judgement and ownership, knowing how to solve problems independently and when to ask for support.

  • Clear, kind communication and a genuine interest in helping people.

  • An AI-native mindset, using AI, automation and technology thoughtfully to simplify work, improve accuracy and increase efficiency.


Bonus if you have:

At Sunday Natural, we’re on a mission to bring premium wellness products to millions of customers across Europe. As we accelerate our growth, we are expanding our acquisition strategy and exploring new ways to connect with customers.

As our Performance Marketing Manager – Native Ads (all genders), you will help build and scale Native Advertising as a new acquisition channel, combining creative storytelling, data-driven campaign management and end-to-end funnel optimisation to drive sustainable growth.

  

Your role:

You will take ownership of our Native Advertising campaigns, from developing compelling ad creatives and advertorials to managing campaigns across platforms such as Taboola and Outbrain and Meta.

Combining creative execution with analytical excellence, you will build, test and optimise entire conversion funnels, leveraging AI-powered tools, performance tracking and continuous experimentation to turn engaging content into measurable business results.

Your mandate: Establish Native Advertising as a scalable, high-performing acquisition channel – transforming creative ideas and data-driven insights into sustainable customer growth.

Native Advertising & Campaign Optimisation

Creative Development & Conversion Funnels

Analytics, Tracking & Collaboration

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Performance Marketing, CRO and external agency partners to develop and scale successful campaigns.

What You Bring:

Proven expertise in managing and optimising campaigns on platforms such as Taboola, Outbrain, Meta or comparable networks. Experience in B2C/D2C, particularly nutrition, food, supplements or wellness, is a strong plus.

  • Creative & Content Expertise: Strong copywriting and storytelling skills, with hands-on experience creating conversion-focused advertorials, ad creatives and landing page content.

  • AI & Automation: You are confident using AI-powered tools to create, test and optimise advertising content and creative assets.

  • Conversion Focus: You understand how creatives, advertorials, landing pages and customer journeys influence conversion rates and campaign profitability.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You work independently, proactively identify opportunities and enjoy building and scaling new initiatives with measurable impact.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, communicate insights clearly and manage external partners effectively.

  • Language Skills: Excellent German (C1 level), including strong copywriting skills, and strong English communication skills.

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • The Urban Sports Club membership and either Swapfiets bike rental or a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket

  • Receive various discounts of up to more than 50 percent on attractive brands such as Flaconi, Bosch, Apple or Expedia

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

title: Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wie ontwerpt het fundament waarop soevereine cloudplatformen kunnen bouwen?

Iedere organisatie die naar schaalbare, soevereine Cloudinfrastructuur beweegt, botst vroeg of laat op dezelfde vraag: wie zorgt dat die infrastructuur betrouwbaar, reproduceerbaar en toekomstbestendig is, zonder in te leveren op controle en portabiliteit? Als Platform Engineer is dat jouw vraagstuk.

De uitdaging

Als Platform Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers zoals Defensie, KLM en ASML, aan complexe infrastructuurvraagstukken op seniorniveau. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert Cloudinfrastructuur en CI/CD-pipelines, geeft vorm aan platformarchitecturen, zoals het deployen van Mendix op Kubernetes-clusters binnen Europese cloudomgevingen, en zet Kubernetes-clusters op binnen Europese Cloudproviders als STACKIT, OVH en Scaleway of binnen private Cloudomgevingen. Met Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform, maak je infrastructuren reproduceerbaar en schaalbaar. Je werkt nauw samen met software-, data- en AI-engineers, en met klanten om infrastructuurbehoeften te vertalen naar betrouwbare oplossingen, met oog voor soevereiniteit, autonomie en portabiliteit.

Je plek: de Platform Engineering squad

Je landt in de Platform Engineering squad, waar collega's elkaar scherp houden op technische keuzes en architectuur. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarop we tijd vrijmaken voor kennisdeling, leren en verbinden met de rest van LINKIT.

Lees hier meer over de Platform Engineering squad.


Wat we vragen

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in een DevOps-, Platform Engineering- of infrastructuurrol, bij voorkeur binnen de Nederlandse overheid.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met containers en orchestratieplatformen zoals Kubernetes en Docker, gecombineerd met CI/CD-tooling zoals GitHub Actions, GitLab CI of Jenkins, en Infrastructure as Code, bijvoorbeeld Terraform.

  • Ervaring met cloud-agnostisch werken binnen publieke en private cloudomgevingen, waaronder Europese providers als STACKIT, OVH en Scaleway en platformen zoals OpenStack.

  • Ervaring met automatisering en scripting, met tools en talen zoals Python, Go, Ansible en/of Chef.

  • Kennis van netwerken, beveiliging en observability binnen cloud-native en on-premise omgevingen.

  • Affiniteit met open-source tooling en moderne data-infrastructuren, zoals datapipelines, datawarehouses, lakehouses en MLOps.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €4.300-€6.700 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop + telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de 'clubdag').

  • Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten,, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  2. Verdiepende gesprekken: twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  3. Aanbieding: als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Wil je alvast meer weten? Neem gerust contact op met Tabea via

Over LINKIT

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Platform Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Über 5 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind pflegebedürftig, und jedes Jahr werden es mehr. Ihnen stehen Leistungen zu, die oft nie ankommen, weil Formulare, Zuständigkeiten und Behördensprache dazwischenstehen.

Jeden Fall einzeln zu prüfen und bis zur Entscheidung zu begleiten, war bisher zu aufwendig. Mit KI geht das zum ersten Mal für viele Familien gleichzeitig. Genau das macht Decari: Wir prüfen, welche Leistungen infrage kommen, etwa ein höherer Pflegegrad, Hilfe zur Pflege oder Eingliederungshilfe, und begleiten die Anträge bis zur Entscheidung. Pflegedienste in mehreren Bundesländern arbeiten bereits mit uns. Unser Ziel: Jede Familie in Deutschland bekommt die Pflegeleistungen, die ihr zusteht.

Wir sind ein kleines, AI-natives Team mit Erfahrung aus der Versicherungs- und Pflegebranche. Wir waren frühe Mitarbeiter in Startups, die von Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures und Y Combinator finanziert wurden und zusammen über 100 Mio. Euro eingesammelt haben. Neue Ideen testen wir erst einfach und von Hand, was funktioniert, automatisieren wir, und unsere Abläufe ändern wir jede Woche, manchmal täglich. Wir übernehmen Ownership und haben wenig Ego.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Rolle baust du Decari mit uns auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit Julien (Operations) und den Gründern und bist operativ und taktisch mittendrin: Du sprichst jeden Tag mit Familien und Pflegediensten, siehst, wo es hakt, und gestaltest den Prozess aktiv mit. Das geht als Pflichtpraktikum oder als Werkstudent:in (bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, tagsüber). Du suchst ein anderes Modell? Sprich uns an.

Berlin, hybrid: im Praktikum mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche im Office, als Werkstudent:in mindestens 2. Start ab sofort, für mindestens 6 Monate, bezahlt, danach ist eine Festanstellung möglich.

Was du machst

  • Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können.

  • Du bringst Fälle ins Ziel. Aus einem guten Gespräch machst du einen vollständigen Fall und bleibst dran, bis alles da ist, was wir für den Antrag brauchen.

  • Du betreust unsere Pflegedienste mit. Für sie bist du die erste Ansprechperson zu ihren Familien.

  • Du verbesserst den Funnel. Du kennst die Zahlen von der Anfrage bis zum Antrag, bringst Ideen ein und testest sie direkt.

  • Du baust mit uns Automatisierungen. Was wir oft genug von Hand gemacht haben, übernimmt danach die KI.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn

  • Du gern telefonierst, auch 50 Mal am Tag, und dich eine Mailbox oder ein Nein nicht aus dem Takt bringt

  • Du gut zuhörst, empathisch bist und schnell und fehlerfrei schreibst

  • Du anpackst und dir für unglamouröse Arbeit nicht zu schade bist

  • Du Ownership übernimmst: Dinge jetzt erledigst, die einfachste Lösung suchst und selbst einen Weg findest, wenn du feststeckst

  • Du KI im Alltag nutzt und neue Tools schnell lernst

  • Du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift besitzt (C1), weil du täglich mit Familien telefonierst und diese berätst. Eine weitere Sprache wie Polnisch, Türkisch, Russisch oder Arabisch ist ein Plus

  • Du studierst und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder einen Werkstudentenjob, zum Beispiel in BWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Sozialer Arbeit oder Jura.

  • Du schon Kundenkontakt hattest, etwa im Nebenjob, in einem Praktikum oder in einem eigenen Projekt

Eher nichts für dich, wenn

  • Du nicht gern telefonierst

  • Du noch nie mit KI- oder Automatisierungstools gearbeitet hast oder dir technisches Grundverständnis fehlt

  • Du nur „strategisch“ arbeiten willst

title: Pre-Sales Engineer - Energy Retail
descriptionHtml:
Location: London or Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer C3

Team: Growth

Salary: £60,000 - £75,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Sales Engineering

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you are a trusted technical contributor within our team, helping deliver impactful sales engagements through configuration and development in our demo environments. You’ll play a contributor role to larger deals, and often lead pre-sales activities for smaller or less complex opportunities. You are a key part of the commercial engine, helping us scale by ensuring our technical pre-sales efforts are thorough, accurate, and client-focused.

This role will report to the Head of Demo Engineering and you’ll be part of a team that works on sales to Kaluza’s largest clients globally. You will have broad expertise on Kaluza’s product suite and our value differentiators and will develop depth in particular areas of our products. You will have a good understanding of the challenges facing energy retailers from a client or user perspective and be able to show-case how our solutions solve them.. 

You will play a crucial role in building product demonstrations and collateral that evangelises the Kaluza platform.

  • Own and deliver demo activities for small to mid-size opportunities, especially during high team capacity periods. This includes configuring and delivering tailored product demonstrations and responding to client technical questions with clarity and confidence.

  • Support technical delivery on complex deals, working alongside senior team members to prepare solution configurations, contribute to discovery conversations, and ensure client requirements are well captured and translated.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to scope solutions, validate feasibility, and communicate trade-offs in a clear and client-friendly manner.

  • Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept (PoC) projects, ensuring they reflect client needs and demonstrate our platform’s ability to deliver measurable outcomes. Track PoC success criteria and highlight risks or gaps to the wider team.

  • Represent the Pre-Sales function in internal planning and alignment sessions, helping ensure technical accuracy, smooth handovers, and clear documentation for post-sale teams.

  • Document and share learnings from client engagements, including product feedback, recurring questions, and potential areas for improvement in our pre-sales approach or demo assets.


What you’ll bring 

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Software development experience in a regulated industry using TypeScript, with a track record of designing and building complex solutions to customer problems

  • Experience architecting solutions on AWS, knowing which technologies to use when and the trade-offs involved

  • Confidence working with and explaining event-driven architectures and asynchronous APIs

  • Experience in a commercial or client-facing technical role, ideally selling SaaS in a regulated industry, with examples of adapting a solution to meet a customer’s unique needs

  • The ability to distil complex concepts into clear, simple points, and to work through differing opinions with empathy

  • Comfort working autonomously across multiple opportunities, handling ambiguity and knowing which data to use to measure success

An interest in renewable energy and the challenges facing energy retailers will help you hit the ground running.

Tech stack: TypeScript, AWS, event-driven architectures, asynchronous APIs


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

descriptionHtml:
Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)


Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.

Deploy is Akur8’s stateless rating engine, delivering subsecond insurance premium computations across a wide range of industry use cases.

It sits at the intersection of two key functions in insurance. Actuaries extract insights from data and make the statistical decisions that shape the business. IT teams, in turn, build and maintain the reliable systems that put those decisions into production.

Today, these two worlds operate with different skills, priorities and tools, connected through slow, manual handoffs between teams.

Deploy replaces this process with a shared foundation that aligns actuarial and IT teams and reduces time-to-market. Building it requires a deep understanding of how both functions are organised, what each is trying to achieve, and the complex ecosystem behind an insurance product and its pricing. This is what makes the role both dynamic and challenging.

At Akur8, we value a builder mindset. We embrace the AI revolution by providing the right tools and removing barriers, so that everyone contributing to product development maximises their impact.

We’re looking for a Pricing Engine Product Manager to join the Deploy team, a cross-functional role focused on solving problems and rapid delivery of results to our customers.

To succeed, you’ll build a solid understanding of how the different parts of our platform interact, allow you to abstract customer problems into a clear framework, turning complex challenges into clean solutions.

We’re interested in people who are motivated by solving problems and comfortable diving deep into the details. You take innovative approaches to find intuitive solutions to seemingly complex problems.

You also share our builder mindset, and you get excited about delivering fast iterations on difficult challenges.

Main responsibilities

  • Continuously deepening your understanding of actuarial ratemaking and IT deployment challenges, including product models and Policy Admin System design.

  • Working at pace, with short iteration cycles, to shape user flows and prototypes that tackle complex API management and distil insurance complexity into clean, opinionated solutions.

  • Defining frameworks and approaches that address user pain points, prioritising what matters and setting aside what doesn’t.

  • Leading user interviews to build a thorough understanding of end users’ challenges and objectives.

For this key role within our Product Management team we’re keen to speak to applicants that meet the following criteria.

  • A Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline

  • 3+ years experience in either the P&C insurance industry or with products managing, defining and orchestrating high performant API connections and integrations.

  • Excellent quantitative & analytical skills

  • Proficient in leveraging LLM tools - and with a product builder mindset focused on delivering fast paced iteration of prototypes

  • Very strong problem solving skills with a focus on providing and creating robust solutions

  • Effective communication skills (to exchange with both technical & non-technical stakeholders / clients).

  • Fluent English language skills



Important: You must possess the authorisation to work in France, although we are equally open to visa sponsorship should you meet the above criteria.

At Akur8, we do value a builder mindset and we embrace the AI revolution by enabling tools and removing barriers to let contributors maximize their impact in our product development.

But it’s not all work, you’ll also be part of a dynamic team that enjoys spending time together and having fun.

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • Hybrid office / home office policy

  • 25 days of paid holidays + RTT

  • Gym membership with Gymlib

  • On-site gym facilities / corporate sporting activities

  • Excellent health insurance (including possibility of family coverage)

  • Swile lunch vouchers

  • Public transportation reimbursement + sustainable mobility allowance

  • Relocation support

  • Sponsored crèche access

  • Free cafeteria with fresh fruit, drinks and snacks

  • Great office in the heart of the 9th arrondissement of Paris

These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.

title: Principal Designer - CDM
descriptionHtml:
At BakerHicks, we’ve grown rapidly in the Transmission & Distribution sector over the last 12 years, delivering projects that make a real difference to communities across the UK. As our portfolio expands, we’re excited to welcome Principal Designer - CDM who share our passion for collaboration, innovation, and creating a sustainable future.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and proactive SR188 Principal Designer Representative (PDR) to support the delivery of a diverse portfolio of National Grid projects across both Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) and construction stages.

Acting on behalf of the Principal Designer under National Grid’s SR188 framework, you will play a key role in ensuring compliance with CDM Regulations 2015, driving high standards of health, safety, and risk management throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the Principal Designer Representative (PD R) in accordance with National Grid’s SR188 requirements.
  • Support and advise clients, designers, and project teams on CDM compliance, including roles, duties, and documentation.
  • Coordinate and manage design risk management processes, ensuring hazards are identified, eliminated, or reduced through design.
  • Facilitate and lead design risk workshops, HAZID/HAZOP sessions, and design reviews.
  • Ensure production and maintenance of key CDM deliverables, including:
    • Design Risk Registers
    • Pre-Construction Information (PCI)
    • Health and Safety Files
  • Provide CDM and safety input, influencing safe-by-design principles early in the project lifecycle.
  • Support project teams through the design and construction phase, ensuring effective communication of residual risks to contractors.
  • Engage with stakeholders including National Grid, contractors, and multidisciplinary design teams.
  • Monitor and report on CDM compliance and performance, identifying areas for improvement.
  • Promote a strong health, safety, and wellbeing culture across all projects.

Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience in a Principal Designer or CDM Advisor role, ideally within the utilities or infrastructure sectors.
  • Strong working knowledge of CDM Regulations 2015 and their practical application.
  • Experience working on National Grid projects and familiarity with SR188 requirements is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrable experience across both FEED/design and construction phases.
  • Ability to lead design risk management activities and influence multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Qualifications

  • Relevant degree or equivalent in engineering, construction, or a related discipline.
  • Professional membership (e.g., APS, IOSH, ICE, IET) desirable.
  • NEBOSH Construction Certificate (or equivalent) desirable.

Personal Attributes

  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong leadership and facilitation skills.
  • High attention to detail with a commitment to safety excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on critical national infrastructure projects.
  • Exposure to a broad range of FEED and construction stage activities.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Professional development and career progression opportunities.

Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels.
The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements.

In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.

Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK) 

About BakerHicks 

We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: About | BakerHicks. 

BakerHicks. A Morgan Sindall Group company.  

Benefits 

Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.  

What you get will depend on what you do, with individual performance-related rewards also on offer in addition to: 

  • Company car or cash allowance 
  • Up to 6% matched contributory pension plan 
  • Life assurance scheme 
  • 25 days annual leave plus ability to buy additional leave 
  • Discount scheme (including gym membership, mobile phones etc) 
  • Flexible/hybrid working 
  • Family friendly policies 
  • Employee assistance 
  • Professional development 

BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.  
BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Role:

We are looking for a curious, smart, and “learn it all” Architect with proven experience and a passion for designing transformative solution architectures for our prospects and customers. This high-impact role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise and executive presence, requiring you to confidently present to C-level executives and translate their strategic goals into actionable technical plans. You will work with technical teams at our prospects and customers to design architectures that drive enterprise modernization, leveraging techniques like capability mapping and exploring innovative solutions with Agentic AI.

Your primary goal is to support our growing sales team in achieving revenue goals by unlocking technical blockers and partnering closely with our Sales, Value Engineering, Product Management, Data Ops, and Information Security teams. You will be responsible for supporting engagements with new prospects as well as existing customers that look to expand their footprint. Measures of success include new customer acquisition rates, retention, up-selling, and contribution to overall sales team and business success.

The work you’ll do:

  • Lead and define the overall architecture, data, and cloud strategy for our largest client accounts, leveraging expertise like enterprise modernization and capability mapping.
  • Confidently engage with and present to customer C-level executives, aligning their strategic objectives with the Celonis technical strategy.
  • Drive innovation by identifying and architecting solutions that leverage emergent technologies, including Agentic AI.
  • Be the bridge between our product & engineering teams within Celonis and the client's teams to provide the best technical services.
  • Assess the IT landscape maturity of our customer installed base for the region.
  • Participate in pre-Sales and post-Sales phases by engaging with customer Architecture and security teams.
  • Coach and guide Celonis consulting teams and ecosystem partners on technical implementation issues such as architecture, integration, performance, and scalability.
  • Develop re-usable assets for the consulting teams on projects.
  • Develop customer-facing position papers, assets, and thought leadership presentations on architecture and innovation with Celonis.
  • Create technical designs and presentations for internal and client stakeholders.

The qualifications you need:

  • 10 to 15 years of relevant experience (e.g., Software vendor Architect, CTO at a top consulting firm, or Enterprise Architect at a customer).
  • Proven ability to think strategically, connecting technical solutions to business value and customer objectives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of presenting complex technical concepts and strategic visions to C-level executives.
  • Demonstrated experience in Capability Mapping, Enterprise Modernization, and a strong understanding of Agentic AI
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS solutions, ERP (particularly SAP S/4HANA or ECC),  Salesforce, Dynamics CRM or ServiceNow), cybersecurity posture fundamentals, API ecosystems, along with legacy on-premise enterprise architectures.
  • Strong background in Data Architecture, Integrations patterns, and a development background in data-related languages (SQL, Python, etc.)
  • Strong technical background with a focus on system integrations, data operations, and automation capabilities.
  • The ability to comfortably switch from explaining an architecture diagram to an environment where you have coded or assembled a demo of that architecture.
  • MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent in an Information Technology-related field.
  • Fluency in English is required; an additional language such as Spanish, German, French or Italian is a strong advantage.

Additional qualifications preferred:

  • Celonis Certifications and Experience with OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
  • AWS/Azure/GCP Certifications.
  • ESB / ETL Certifications (Mulesoft, Oracle, SAP, Talend, Informatica).
  • TOGAF/Zachmann Certification.
  • Experience in at least two domains among: Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Customer/Consumer Management (Service, Order Management, Sales), HR, Procurement.
  • Experience in at least two industries among: Consumer Goods, Banking, Pharma, Aerospace, Telco, Transport.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

  • Du wirkst bei der Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen basierend auf der aktuellen Bedrohungslage (Threat Modelling / Threat Intelligence) und regulatorischen Vorgaben mit.
  • Du unterstützt unseren CISO bei der Erstellung von Schulungs- und Awareness-Programmen und begleitest das Projekt- und Changemanagement bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von IKT-Systemen und -Anwendungen.

  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung mit Security-Tooling (SIEM, EDR, DLP, VPN/SASE) sowie mit Security im AWS-Cloud-Umfeld und SaaS-Anwendungen.
  • Du hast bereits erfolgreich mit einem externen Security Operations Center (SOC) zusammengearbeitet.

  • Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Englisch- und gute Deutschkenntnisse.

Warum wir?

  • Wir sind ein internationales / grenzüberschreitendes Team, das eng zusammenarbeitet.
  • Wir sind ein kleines Team, so hast du Einfluss auf die Teamkultur und das Produkt.
  • Bei uns bekommst du die Freiheit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Wir bieten dir regelmäßige Coachings und Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder von unserem zentralen Büro in Frankfurt zu arbeiten.

title: Principal Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
You’ll be a Technical Leader, unblock the engineering team by resolving complex technical impasses, standardising engineering practices, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

You'll still be a highly hands-on engineer, responsible for rapidly prototyping, shipping MVPs, and turning product ideas into polished user experiences. You’ll work across the stack, collaborating closely with product, design, and engineering teams while operating with a high degree of independence.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Build and ship new product features end-to-end

  • Lead rapid prototyping and MVP development

  • Develop modern frontend applications using TypeScript, Vue 3 Composition API, and Tailwind

  • Contribute to backend services using Node, Bun, Koa, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and AWS

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to shape product direction

  • Improve performance, reliability, and developer experience across the platfor

  • Support on hiring, performance and technical roadmaps.

 

What you'll need

 

  • Extensive experience building modern frontend applications with TypeScript and Vue3

  • Solid backend experience with Node-based services and relational databases

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, Prisma, AWS, and REST APIs

  • Comfortable moving quickly, making pragmatic decisions, and shipping iteratively

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Able to work independently in a hybrid environment

  • Ideally have been in early stage start-ups going through growth and technical challenges

 

What you'll get

  • Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off

  • Flexible hybrid working: Work in a way that helps you do your best work, while staying connected with the team.

  • A stake in what we’re building: Eligible employees can participate in our EMI share option scheme.

  • Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover.

  • More ways to get around: Access our company car salary-sacrifice scheme.

  • Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.


About Cytix

  • Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

  • That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

    We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

     

    Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

     

    Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

     

    See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

     

    Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

     

    Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

    Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

Compensation: £100K – £120K • Equity

title: Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Every business is using AI. The ones that get it right start with real people. GWI is the human intelligence underneath: verified data that helps businesses understand what moves their audience, and act on it faster. If you want your work to matter, keep reading.


What will I be doing? 

As our Product Designer you’ll design how people and AI agents get to GWI data, working in a cross-functional squad alongside Product and Engineering.

Right now our biggest need is agentic, API and MCP. Customers reach GWI through agents, integrations and workflows as well as our platform, so you’ll shape the experiences built on our MCP servers and APIs: how a developer connects to an endpoint, how an agent calls a tool and gets a trustworthy answer, and how a person stays in control when it goes wrong. That’s where you’ll start, but there’s room to work in other squads and domains as our priorities change.

A few things you’ll be responsible for:

  • Taking problems from discovery through to delivery, partnering with Product Managers, Engineers and Data teams.
  • Designing the experiences around our MCP servers and APIs (onboarding, authentication, tool and endpoint discovery, error handling, usage and permissions) and improving the workflows that take developers, analysts and AI agents to trusted data.
  • Designing for agents and machines as well as people, working with Engineering on tools, schemas, naming and error messages so the machine-facing and human-facing sides feel like one product.
  • Using AI to speed up discovery, design and delivery, and prototyping with working code and live APIs so ideas get tested early.
  • Contributing to our design system: proposing, designing and documenting components and patterns, including agentic and API-led ones, and working with Engineering to implement them consistently.
  • Contributing to developer-facing content such as documentation, quickstarts and example flows.

Working at GWI means a high tempo environment where change is common. We’re building quickly because the industry is moving quickly, and our customers rely on us to stay ahead. If you like being part of that, you’ll enjoy it here.


What do I need to bring with me? 

You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don’t have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn.

  • Fluency with AI tools: you use them to prototype quickly, ideally against live APIs or in code, as well as to speed up research and design.
  • Strong design system knowledge: you’ve built or extended components and patterns, written usage guidance, and helped keep a product consistent.
  • Some experience with API or MCP workflows, or agentic products (or a strong appetite to learn fast), and an understanding of how APIs work (REST, authentication, rate limits, schemas, errors) and how they shape the experience.
  • A solid product design and UX foundation, with a good grasp of interaction design and usability, and comfort in complex, technical product environments.
  • Strong problem-solving and systems thinking: you break problems down, land on clear solutions, and see how a tool, an API response or an agent interaction fits into the wider journey.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and a collaborative, proactive approach that makes the team around you better.
  • Independence within your squad, the judgement to seek input on the more ambiguous challenges, and the curiosity to pick things up quickly and adapt when priorities change.
  • Proficiency with Figma, FigJam and Jira, and experience using qualitative and quantitative insights to inform decisions.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing developer tools, API documentation or developer portals.
  • Hands-on experience building MCP servers.
  • Experience with data products, analytics or market research platforms.
  • Experience with a design system that covers non-visual patterns, such as API error messaging, agent interaction states or developer documentation.
  • A track record of introducing a new process, tool or practice that your team adopted.
  • Experience running lightweight research with technical users, such as developers and data analysts.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on a problem few teams have solved: designing how AI agents and developers get to trusted data through our MCP servers and APIs.

title: Product Lead
descriptionHtml:
About Abound

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.


And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.


Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The Role

We are hiring a Product Lead to own our Express / Mid-prime personal loan product, one of our highest-priority growth areas. This is unsecured personal lending in the higher-APR mid-prime space (30% to 50% APR), with loans typically from £2,000 to £10,000, and customers acquired primarily through price-comparison and aggregator marketplaces. Our ambition is to grow this product many times over while improving its economics, and this role owns the product that makes that happen.

This is a product role first. You will own the Express/Mid-prime proposition end to end: who we serve, how we quote and present offers on marketplaces, how the journey converts, how we price, and how the product performs once the loans are on the book. What makes it different from a typical product role is that the product is credit. The levers that drive growth, such as eligibility, pricing, offer design and underwriting, are the same levers that drive loss rates, so you need to be comfortable working with risk and data science rather than handing that part off.

We think this is a great role for someone with around four to five years of experience who has built a strong foundation in lending or fintech, has worked hands-on with data and credit decisioning, and is ready to own a product outright rather than a slice of one. You will set the direction for the segment, run the roadmap, and be accountable for the results, with the backing of experienced risk, data science and commercial leaders around you.

Our decisioning is built on Open Banking and cashflow underwriting rather than credit scores alone. For a higher-APR population acquired through marketplaces, seeing real affordability is what lets us select and price better than the market. The interesting product problem is that richer data comes at a cost to conversion, so the job is to capture that data advantage while designing a journey and offer that customers actually complete.

The defining challenge is balance: scaling volume by an order of magnitude while building a book of genuinely good credit quality. The best people in this space know that those two goals can be reconciled rather than traded off, and are curious enough to work out how.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the Express / Mid-prime product: proposition, roadmap, performance and economics, with direct accountability for the balance between growth and credit quality.

  • Lead how we quote and present offers across aggregator and price-comparison marketplaces, optimising eligibility, risk-based pricing and offer presentation to win the right customers at the point of acquisition.

  • Own conversion through the journey, from quote to disbursal, including how we ask customers for Open Banking data and how that affects drop-off and the quality of the book.

  • Understand and actively manage adverse selection in marketplace-acquired lending, shaping offer, pricing and decisioning strategy to attract the customers we want and screen out the risk we do not.

  • Work with data science to make sure our credit models are calibrated and tuned for this population rather than inherited unchanged from prime or adjacent segments, and be able to get into the data yourself when needed.

  • Use credit and commercial insight to optimise unit economics, balancing approval rates, pricing, loss rates and volume so the product scales profitably.

  • Monitor product and portfolio performance across the customer lifecycle, spotting emerging trends, risks and opportunities early.

  • Shape underwriting strategy, segmentation, credit policy and decisioning logic in partnership with risk and data science.

  • Design and evaluate experiments and strategy changes, and turn the analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Own the management information for the segment: define the metrics, monitoring and reporting that let the business make consistent decisions about the product.

  • Assess new initiatives, customer segments and product changes with both a commercial and a credit lens.

  • Present clear, structured updates on product performance to senior leadership and governance forums, and support funding and due diligence conversations where the product is in focus.

Who you are

  • A product person at heart: you care about the customer, the journey and the commercial outcome, and you want to own something end to end.

  • Quantitative and hands-on. You are comfortable in SQL and Python (or similar), you can interrogate a dataset yourself, and you can hold your own in a conversation with data scientists about model performance and calibration.

  • Credit-literate. You understand how eligibility, pricing and underwriting decisions shape the book you end up with, and you have a working understanding of adverse selection and why it matters in marketplace lending.

  • Commercially sharp, with a solid grasp of unit economics and a clear understanding that product decisions in lending have to work for both growth and portfolio performance.

  • Curious about trade-offs rather than defensive about them: alert to the fact that deeper affordability assessment can hurt conversion, and motivated by the challenge of capturing its value without sacrificing growth.

  • Able to move between detail and direction: happy getting into the data on a Tuesday and shaping the roadmap on a Wednesday.

  • Confident challenging assumptions and turning analysis into practical action, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to people who are not analysts.

  • Collaborative and credible with risk, commercial, engineering and data science teams.

  • Structured, proactive and comfortable in a scaling environment where priorities evolve quickly and ownership is expected.

Experience and background

  • Around four to five years of experience in product, credit strategy, analytics or a closely related role within consumer lending or fintech. We are deliberately targeting this level: this is a step-up role for someone ready to own a product, not a lateral move for someone who has run several.

  • Experience in unsecured consumer lending, ideally Unsecured Personal Loans (UPL), with exposure to the mechanics of acquiring customers through price-comparison or aggregator marketplaces. Direct experience in higher-APR or near-prime lending is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

  • Hands-on data skills: SQL as a minimum, and ideally Python or R for analysis. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you need to be able to work alongside them as a peer and do your own analysis.

  • Experience working with or alongside credit decisioning, scorecards or risk models, and an understanding of how they are built, monitored and adjusted for a specific population.

  • Some experience of pricing, eligibility or offer design, and of using experiments or A/B tests to evaluate changes.

  • A track record of using analysis to influence decisions, not just to report on outcomes, in a role where you had some accountability for commercial results.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience with Open Banking data or cashflow underwriting is a plus, as is experience in a fast-growing fintech.

What we offer:

  • 2 paid volunteering days per year

  • One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

  • Free gym membership

  • Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

Product Manager

Location: UK (remote)

Job Description

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Product Manager to join us.

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Define problems and experiences before solutions, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.
  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.
  • You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.
  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.
  • You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.
  • You have a strong sense of product and user experience, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.

The benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.
