title: Senior Financial Systems Architect - Workday
descriptionHtml:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

What You'll Do

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • At least five (5+) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

We’d be particularly excited if

  • Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.

  • Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

title: Senior GRC Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.
  • Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program. 
  • Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash’s regulatory environment, not just document them.
  • Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance. 
  • Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into.
  • Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls. 

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track record in high-growth, technology-driven and regulated environments. 
  • Hands-on experience building large language models and agent workflows with daily use of AI in your own work, grounded judgment on what to delegate to agents versus what needs a human, and the ability to evidence both to an auditor. DoorDash is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in this role.
  • The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 and CRA. 
  • Real, hands-on experience implementing and assessing controls against frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 - not just reading them.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, assess risk and drive remediation in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • Experience developing, implementing and improving security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are operational and effective.
  • Strong understanding of compliance metrics and reporting, with the ability to track control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and risk exposure. 
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance. 
  • Comfort owning compliance metrics and reporting - you can show, not just assert, that a program is working.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Senior Group Treasury Systems Manager

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future Treasury technology landscape within a global organisation, driving strategic change while delivering tangible business value.

What you'll need:

  • Proven experience implementing, managing, or supporting Treasury Management Systems within a corporate or financial services environment.
  • Strong understanding of UK and international treasury operations, including cash management, liquidity, financial instruments, and regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated project management expertise, with a track record of delivering complex transformation and systems initiatives on time and within budget.
  • Advanced analytical skills, including strong proficiency in Excel, reporting tools, and data-driven decision-making.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

The Opportunity
We’re looking for an experienced Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with strong AWS and cloud security expertise to join our global Infrastructure Operations team. You’ll architect, build, secure and maintain the cloud infrastructure behind Coda’s platforms. Beyond daily operations, you’ll help us manage infrastructure better at scale, strengthen our AWS security and make changes safer and simpler for engineering teams. You’ll work closely with engineers across the company to solve infrastructure challenges, improve reliability and cut down manual work through automation.

  • Design, build and maintain secure, scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure across multiple accounts and regions

  • Familiar with monitoring tools like Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry, with strong troubleshooting skills and a collaborative way of working across engineering teams
  • It’s a plus if you’ve worked with security automation tools like Cloud Custodian, Checkov or Trivy, know standards such as PCI DSS or the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark, have experience with high traffic distributed systems or payment platforms, or hold an AWS certification like Security Specialty, Solutions Architect or Advanced Networking

title: Senior Kreditorenbuchhalter (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Job

• Verantwortung für den Prozess: Du behältst den gesamten Purchase-to-Pay-Prozess (P2P) im Blick – von Bestellung über Wareneingang und Rechnungsprüfung bis zur Zahlung – und arbeitest eng mit den beteiligten Teams zusammen.

Dein Profil

'• Fundierte Praxis in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung: Du beherrschst das operative Geschäft sicher, priorisierst auch bei hohem Belegaufkommen gut und lieferst eigenständig präzise Ergebnisse.

• End-to-End-Verständnis: Du kennst die wesentlichen Teilbereiche des P2P-Prozesses aus der Praxis und hast bereits Projekte zur Analyse oder Verbesserung bereichsübergreifender Abläufe begleitet.

• SAP-Erfahrung: Du hast in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung mit SAP gearbeitet; Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA ist besonders willkommen.

• Gestaltungswille: Du hinterfragst Routinen konstruktiv, denkst über die eigene Aufgabe hinaus und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch um.

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

title: Senior Localisation Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview

We are seeking a Senior Localisation Quality Engineer, a highly skilled and innovative individual who brings together design-phase product thinking, software engineering expertise, localisation awareness, and technical problem solving.

The role builds on the core responsibilities of a Senior Localisation QA Engineer, combining strong localization quality expertise with software engineering, automation, and earlier involvement in the product design and development lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone who has worked closely with design teams in Figma, has experience reviewing and validating designs before implementation, understands how localisation impacts product and UI design, and can build scalable technical solutions to improve quality across the product lifecycle. You will partner with design, engineering, product, and localisation teams to identify risks early, improve design quality and localisation readiness, and create tools, systems, and solutions that enable faster and smarter delivery.

Rather than focusing only on post-implementation testing, this role emphasises early engagement in the design phase, including reviewing Figma files, prototypes, design systems, user flows, and content structures to ensure they are scalable, testable, and ready for localisation across languages and regions. You will also contribute as a hands-on engineer, building software, automation, integrations, and AI-driven solutions such as agents, assistants, or plugins that improve workflows, validation, and quality decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines strong software development skills, experience working with design systems and Figma-based workflows, practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation, and hands-on interest in engineering solutions to product and quality challenges.

Responsibilities

Design Systems, Figma & Early Product Quality

- Partner with designers, product managers, engineers, and the wider Localisation team to help identify localisation risks early in the design phase.
- Support the Localisation team by reviewing Figma designs and providing technical and design expertise to improve localisation readiness before implementation.
- Help the Localisation team identify and address design risks such as text expansion, truncation, layout issues, bidirectional languages, locale-aware components, and cross-market scalability.
- .Build and improve tools, automation, and processes that enable Localisation QA to identify issues earlier and at scale, including automated design and content validation, screenshot capture, localisation readiness checks, and quality validation across languages and regions.
- Work with the wider Localisation team to define best practices and guidance that help designers and engineers create products that are ready for localisation from the start.
- Collaborate with design teams on design systems, UI patterns, and content structures to improve quality and reduce downstream issues before code is written.
- Help define quality expectations, localisation considerations, and implementation guidance directly from design artefacts and product requirements.

Localisation Quality & Testing

- Perform hands-on Localisation QA testing across multiple languages, platforms, products, and regions, including linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation testing.
- Lead and support complex localisation quality initiatives, while contributing directly to day-to-day testing when needed.
- Develop and improve localisation test strategies covering linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation quality.
- Investigate complex localisation and internationalisation issues and work with engineering, design, product, and localisation teams to identify root causes and appropriate solutions.
- Help define localisation quality standards and ensure localisation considerations are integrated throughout the product development lifecycle, from design through implementation and release.

Software Engineering & Technical Solutions

- Design and develop software, internal tools, automation, and reusable services that improve product quality, design validation, and workflow efficiency.
- Build scalable software solutions that support validation of product experiences across design, development, and release stages.
- Contribute to codebases, frameworks, and technical infrastructure that improve quality signals, design consistency, and localisation support.
- Partner with software engineers to improve feature readiness, system testability, and quality-by-design practices.
- Integrate validation and quality workflows into modern development environments and CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

Automation, Tooling & Process Improvement

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve localisation and product quality across design, engineering, and localisation workflows.
- Design and build tools, automation, integrations, or other technical solutions that help teams review designs, validate content, detect issues, and improve workflows.
- Choose the right technical approach for each problem, which may include traditional automation, scripts, plugins, APIs, AI/LLMs, or existing internal tools.
- Develop solutions that help identify localisation and quality issues earlier in the product lifecycle and provide faster feedback to teams.
- Prototype and test new approaches, measure their value, and develop successful solutions so they can be used by the wider Localisation team and potentially other teams.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Act as a bridge across design, engineering, product, and localisation teams, helping align quality, scalability, and user experience goals.
- Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex issues into actionable recommendations.
- Influence teams toward a shift-left, design-led quality approach.
- Contribute to planning, design reviews, implementation discussions, and release readiness with a focus on preventing issues early.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to members of the Localisation team, sharing engineering, automation, localisation, and quality best practices.
- Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Design Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in software engineering, design technology, quality engineering, localisation engineering, or related product development roles.
- Strong hands-on experience in software development, with the ability to build tools, systems, integrations, or automation that solve real product challenges.
- Experience working closely with design teams and Figma workflows, including reviewing designs, prototypes, component systems, and user journeys before implementation.
- Experience validating or testing Figma designs for quality, scalability, localisation readiness, and implementation feasibility.
- Practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation principles in digital products.
- Experience with localisation quality or testing across multilingual products, platforms, or regions.
- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java.
- Hands-on experience building or experimenting with AI agents, plugins, copilots, or intelligent workflow tools.
- Experience with APIs, structured data, system integrations, and modern software development practices.
- Familiarity with developer collaboration tools such as GitHub, JIRA, and Confluence.
- Strong understanding of product development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and cross-functional delivery models.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong product thinking and problem-solving ability.
  • Comfortable operating across design, engineering, product, and localisation domains.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and effective in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organisational and stakeholder management skills.

Desired qualifications

  • Experience with Figma design systems, component libraries, and design-to-development workflows.
  • Experience creating or contributing to Figma plugins, design validation tools, or workflow extensions.
  • Experience building AI agents, assistants, or plugins for design, engineering, content, or localisation use cases.
  • Experience influencing product quality earlier in the lifecycle through design review and engineering collaboration.
  • Familiarity with multilingual product development, translation workflows, or international launch readiness.
  • Experience in video games, consumer technology, digital entertainment, or large-scale product environments.
  • Fluency in one or more non-English languages is a plus.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape next-generation quality, localisation, and design-to-development practices.
  • A dynamic and inclusive workplace where technical excellence, collaboration, and global impact thrive.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Career growth opportunities in a forward-looking engineering environment focused on quality, localisation, automation, intelligent systems, and early product excellence.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

title: Senior logistiek medewerker Meppel
descriptionHtml:
Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou. Je werkt actief mee op de werkvloer, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat onze operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken in ons depot in Meppel. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast rooster met wisselende diensten:

  • 01:00 - 09:30 uur (nacht/ochtend);

  • 13:30 - 22:00 uur (middag/avond).

Je bent bereid beide diensten te werken volgens een vooraf vastgesteld rooster.


Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker begeleid je collega's op de werkvloer en ondersteun je de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse operatie.

  • Laden, lossen, sorteren en scannen van pakketten.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en begeleiden.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en helpen oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in het proces.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's is een pre.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en neemt initiatief.

  • Je houdt overzicht en hebt oog voor mensen én processen.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  1. Kennismaking: we leren elkaar beter kennen tijdens een eerste gesprek.

  2. Assessment: je maakt een online assessment thuis.

  3. Tweede gesprek: we bespreken de resultaten en gaan verder in op de functie.

  4. Aanbod: is er een match? Dan doen we je een aanbod.

Vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.

title: Senior Manager, Data Platform
descriptionHtml:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Data Platform to lead our UK data engineering organisation and drive the development of a scalable, standardised data foundation across our international markets.

In this role, you will lead a lean, multidisciplinary technical team spanning Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineering, growing the team to  6+ people by the end of 2027. You will be responsible for the technical direction, operational resilience, and delivery effectiveness of the platform, ensuring that engineering resources are sharply directed toward the highest-value commercial, product, and technical priorities.

You will partner closely with Product, Commercial, Clinical, and Operations leaders in the UK, as well as Data and Technology leadership in Australia, to align regional architecture with our broader international data strategy.

This is a critical transformation phase: over the next year, your team will enable the launch of three to five new markets and execute the migration of two international businesses onto our shared data infrastructure, including complex transitions from Databricks and Redshift to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

This is a senior leadership role requiring a balance of strong architectural judgement, technical credibility, and the ability to operate fluidly across strategic planning, people leadership, and hands-on platform transformation.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary UK data platform team across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Science/MLE.
  • Define the roadmap, technical priorities, and operating model for the data platform, ensuring engineering investments are effectively aligned to key business initiatives.
  • Oversee and execute the migration of international data ecosystems onto a shared GCP infrastructure (specifically driving the transition from Databricks and Redshift).
  • Collaborate globally with Data and Technology leadership to architect a consistent, highly scalable, and internationally aligned data infrastructure.
  • Partner with UK Product, Commercial, Analytics, and Operations leaders to shape and deliver a resilient international data roadmap.
  • Drive the core data platform execution and scaling required to seamlessly support the launch of new markets and brands.
  • Provide authoritative technical leadership and sound architectural judgement across data pipelines, ML infrastructure, and overall cloud platform decisions.
  • Cultivate a high-performing, accountable engineering environment with strong technical standards, clear ownership, and sustainable software delivery practices.

About You

  • 8+ years of technical experience encompassing data engineering, platform engineering, machine learning operations, or core data science.
  • 3+ years of management experience, successfully leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating a modern, scalable cloud data platform.
  • Strong foundation in data or platform engineering, with the hands-on credibility to guide architecture, code standards, and infrastructure decisions.
  • Exceptional product judgement with the ability to connect underlying technical investments directly to tangible business outcomes.
  • Proven ability to prioritise ruthlessly, manage competing operational demands, and create clarity in dynamic or ambiguous environments.
  • Strong influencing and translation skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical engineering teams and senior business stakeholders.
  • Ideally, you bring a track record of leading complex platform migrations (especially into GCP environments), supporting international market expansions, or driving large-scale technology transformations.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

title: Senior Manager, FP&A (Consolidation and G&A)
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll own Airwallex’s consolidated management P&L view and financial outlook, helping senior leaders understand performance, assess trade-offs and allocate resources. You’ll also be the lead finance partner to our corporate functions, including Operations, Finance, Regulatory & Compliance, Legal, People & Talent, and Communications & Government Affairs.

This is a hands-on role that combines rigorous financial planning and analysis with business partnership. You’ll work through the details, connect the implications across the business, and help leaders make informed decisions about investment, capacity and efficiency.

  • Lead consolidated planning and forecasting. Own the annual budget and quarterly forecast process, bringing together inputs across revenue, gross profit and operating expenditure. Challenge assumptions, resolve inconsistencies across plans, and ensure alignment with Airwallex’s strategic priorities, long-range plan and EBITDA targets.

  • Translate company-wide performance into decisions. Lead monthly management reporting and performance reviews, explaining the drivers of results and their implications for the outlook. Identify material risks and opportunities, build scenarios to assess trade-offs, and recommend actions to senior management.

  • Partner with corporate leaders on resource allocation. Translate business priorities into headcount and spending plans, evaluate investment requests and vendor commitments, and challenge assumptions. Help leaders prioritise resources while balancing financial discipline with capacity, service quality and control requirements.

  • Partner with People & Talent on workforce planning. Build and maintain the consolidated headcount and employee cost forecast with finance and business owners. Assess the implications of hiring pace, workforce mix and organisational changes, and keep hiring plans, budgets and forecasts aligned.

  • Drive operating leverage across corporate functions. Develop cost, capacity and productivity measures suited to each function. Evaluate opportunities through automation, process improvements and vendor arrangements, and track whether investments deliver the expected outcomes.

  • Strengthen FP&A tools, data and processes. title: (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

Als (Senior) Marketplace Manager verantwortest du unsere Präsenz auf den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen Europas, strategisch wie operativ. Du hast Ownership für Performance, Profitabilität und Markenauftritt deiner Kanäle und entscheidest aktiv mit, wie wir TEVEO auf den Plattformen positionieren.

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Marke und Plattform. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit E-Commerce, Operations, Marketing, Finance und externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass sich unser Community-Spirit auf jedem Marktplatz genauso anfühlt wie in unserem eigenen Shop.

Wichtig: Das ist keine reine Strategie-Rolle. Du bist hands-on unterwegs, packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an und setzt deine Ideen eigenständig um, vom Produktfeed über die Kampagne bis zur SLA-Kennzahl.

Dein Bereich als (Senior) Marketplace Manager (m/w/d):
Strategie & Wachstum

  • Du entwickelst unsere Marketplace-Strategie für Europa und setzt sie um: Sortiment, Pricing, Promotions und die Erschließung neuer Marktplätze und Länder.
  • Du verantwortest die Umsatz- und Ergebnisziele deiner Kanäle (GMV, NMV, Deckungsbeitrag) und steuerst sie über klare KPIs wie Conversion, Retourenquote und Sichtbarkeit.
  • Du bewertest Marktpotenziale, erstellst Business Cases für neue Plattformen und leitest daraus Empfehlungen für das Management ab.
  • Du legst fest, welche Essentials wir dauerhaft listen und welche Drops exklusiv bleiben, und entwickelst Launchkonzepte je Marktplatz.

Account- und Plattformsteuerung

  • Du führst unsere Partnerschaften mit den führenden Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen eigenverantwortlich. Dazu gehören Jahresgespräche, Konditions- und Promotion-Verhandlungen und das Platzieren von Aktionen und Kampagnen.
  • Du verantwortest die CXM- und SLA-Kennzahlen (On-Time, Return Time, Valid Tracking), erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und setzt Maßnahmen konsequent um.
  • Du steuerst Feed- und Attributmanagement über unsere Middleware (Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä.) und treibst die Weiterentwicklung der Schnittstellen und Prozesse voran.

Content, Visibility & Brand Experience

  • Du bist Marken-Wächter auf allen Plattformen und sorgst für einen einheitlichen Auftritt in Bildsprache, Texten, Pricing und Promotions.
  • Du planst Kampagnen, Launches und Retail-Media-Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit Marketing und steuerst die Budgets für Retail Media.
  • Du optimierst Produktdaten, Content-Qualität und Conversion und stellst sicher, dass unsere Produkte sauber und performant ausgespielt werden.

Operations & Data

  • Du verantwortest Forecasting, Bestandsplanung und Replenishment für die Marktplätze in enger Abstimmung mit Operations.
  • Du steuerst die Abläufe rund um Versand und Retouren, z. B. über Fulfillment- und Retourenprogramme der Plattformen oder eigene Carrier-Setups, und optimierst sie hinsichtlich Kosten und SLA-Erfüllung.
  • Du baust das Marketplace-Reporting auf und aus und übersetzt Zahlen in klare Entscheidungen für Management und Finance.

Partner & Dienstleister

  • Du steuerst externe Partner und Dienstleister wie Agenturen und Middleware-Anbieter.

Dein Profil

Deine Stärken die wir in unserem Team brauchen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, E-Commerce, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Commerce- oder Marketplace-Management, idealerweise im Fashion- oder Sportswear-Umfeld; für die Senior-Rolle nachweisliche Verantwortung für einen Marktplatz-Kanal inklusive Umsatzzielen
  • Fundiertes Know-how in Marktplatzprozessen, Fulfillment-Setups und Provisionsstrukturen; Erfahrung mit großen Fashion- und Sport-Marktplätzen ist ein großes Plus
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Tradebyte, ChannelEngine o. ä., Looker Studio und Excel/Sheets
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Stärke, unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Gespür für die Balance aus Performance und Brand-Ästhetik
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du arbeitest gern selbst im Tagesgeschäft mit, statt nur zu delegieren, und setzt Dinge schnell und pragmatisch um
  • Verhandlungsstärke und Souveränität im Umgang mit Plattformpartnern und internen Stakeholdern
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Warum wir?

Deine Perspektiven:

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Spannende und vielseitige Aufgaben, die viel Eigeninitiative erfordern
  • Regelmäßige Feedback Gespräche und transparente Kommunikation
  • Zukunftsorientierte Tätigkeit in einem innovativen Unternehmen

Unsere Benefits:

  • Zukunftssicherheit mit Extras
    Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und baue dir entspannt deine finanzielle Absicherung auf – wir unterstützen dich dabei mit einem monatlichen Zuschuss.
  • Familienfreundlichkeit im Fokus
    Wir entlasten dich bei den Betreuungskosten durch einen monatlichen Zuschuss zur Kinderbetreuung – damit Familie und Beruf gut zusammenpassen.
  • Flexibilität durch digitale Benefits
    Ob Shopping, Tanken oder Freizeitaktivitäten – du erhältst ein monatliches Guthaben, das du ganz nach deinen Wünschen einsetzen kannst. Alternativ kannst du mit Wellpass deutschlandweit auf über 8.000 Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote zugreifen – online oder vor Ort – und profitierst dabei von unserem attraktiven Firmenrabatt.
  • Fitness direkt im Haus
    Kein Zeitverlust – nutze unser hauseigenes Gym, um dich vor, während oder nach der Arbeit fit zu halten.
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte
    Sichere dir exklusive Vergünstigungen auf unsere Marken – mit satten Rabatten auf Produkte von TEVEO, fayn. und Meek & Hon.
  • Kostenloses Laden von E-Autos
    An unserem Standort in Ansbach kannst du dein E-Fahrzeug bequem und kostenlos laden – nachhaltig und praktisch.

Selbstverständlich ist für uns: Wasser, Kaffee und verschiedene Milchsorten in unseren Offices in Hamburg und Ansbach.

Onboarding vor Ort:
In den ersten zwei Monaten ermöglichen wir dir unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere Kultur persönlich kennenzulernen – so legen wir gemeinsam die Basis für die Zusammenarbeit in der Zukunft.

Unser Home Office Modell:
Ab dem dritten Monat hast du die Möglichkeit, einen Tag pro Woche im Home Office zu arbeiten. Ab dem 7. Monat hast du die Möglichkeit 2 Tage pro Woche im Home Office zu arbeiten.

Die Lage der Home Office – Tage wirst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit deiner Führungskraft passend regeln – für eine optimale Work- Life Balance.

Bewirb dich jetzt, wenn du dich in unserer Beschreibung wieder erkennst, Teil eines dynamischen Teams werden möchtest und Freude daran hast, mit deiner Leistung zu begeistern. Bitte sende uns dein Motivationsschreiben, deinen Lebenslauf und deinen möglichen Eintrittstermin für unseren Standort in Ansbach.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen.

Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.

Deine Chance

Als Senior People Operations Generalist (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group bringst du deine operative HR-Expertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld mit klarer Mission ein. Operative Exzellenz & Compliance sicherstellen

descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Infrastructure Engineering and Tooling Team 👋

The Infrastructure Engineering and Tooling team, also known as Atlas, owns the ecosystem we use to deploy, run and manage services across the Trainline platform. Our work helps engineering teams across the business ship changes safely and confidently, so millions of travellers can rely on Trainline every day.

You'll join a collaborative team of software and platform engineers at all levels of experience. We work across Terraform, AWS, Node.js, C# and Python, and we don't expect you to know it all from day one. You'll work closely with engineers, Tech Leads, Engineering Managers, a Senior Principal Engineer and the Head of Engineering to improve our platform, shape delivery and deliver meaningful infrastructure change.

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • Substantial professional experience as a software engineer, writing code in Python, Node.js, C# or a similar programming language.

  • Experience of delivering results in agile, delivery-focused teams, and ideally of supporting colleagues through reviews and feedback.

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

title: Senior Product Manager, Software
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own how our device software behaves. You'll take the product vision and turn it into features our software team can build with confidence.

This is product work at the level of detail. You'll think through how features should behave in every situation, including the edge cases, and give the team clear answers. You'll also make sure that work gets delivered. That means keeping the backlog in shape, setting priorities and following features through to release. You'll start on future releases of CoMind One, our first product, and help shape CoVision as it moves towards delivery. As the team and product line grow, so does the role.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Define how features work, step by step, including the edge cases and failure modes that matter in a clinical setting.

  • Package features for build: what it does, why it matters, what it looks like, and the decision logic behind it.

  • Prototype flows and interactions using AI tools, so the team sees the idea before they build it.

  • Sit with the software team and make the call when a feature question comes up.

  • Act as the link between our commercial team and the software team, turning customer and market needs into clear requirements. Use quick prototypes to test those needs with customers and the commercial team before they reach the backlog.

  • Shape the product roadmap with the Product Lead.

  • Own the software backlog in Jira: intake, triage and grooming, so it reflects real priority.

  • Write acceptance criteria and check that what ships matches what was intended.

  • Partner with the Project Manager, who runs sprints, so sequencing and timing reflect real priority rather than convenience.

  • Keep decisions and documentation in Confluence, not lost in Slack.

  • AI is fundamental to our culture — it's not just a tool, but a core part of how we work, collaborate, and innovate. We expect all team members to embrace AI in their daily work and continuously find new ways to use it effectively.

Skills & Experience:

  • Demonstrable product management experience on software that runs on physical hardware.

  • You understand the pace of regulated hardware: long development cycles and infrequent releases.

  • Evidence of making product decisions from logic and a deep understanding of users.

  • Writing requirements precise enough for engineers to build without repeated back-and-forth.

  • You're comfortable debating a feature with engineers and explaining why it matters for the product.

  • A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your day-to-day work.

  • Hands-on experience building interactive prototypes, using AI tools to turn an idea into something clickable that users and engineers can react to.

Nice to have:

  • Medical device experience, or exposure to ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

  • Software engineering or technical background.

  • Experience with embedded or real-time software.

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life insurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

title: Senior Product Manager - Trading
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

The Role:

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Rosso.

This is the second product manager on Rosso, reporting into the Rosso Product Lead. Rosso is deeply technical, built on ML-led models and complex engineering covering forecasting, pricing optimisation and portfolio balancing, so this is a role for a technically-minded PM who's happiest closest to the hardest problems. You'll work on complex, important problems as they arise across the Rosso product surface, alongside the other PM on the team, rather than owning one fixed patch. In the near term that means the portfolio area: fulfilling and balancing a growing two-sided portfolio, managing imbalance, and finding the revenue and margin in every position we hold. It's still forming, it carries live financial risk, and it needs someone who wants to win in it.

You will:

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible, shipped product, working closely enough to the ML and forecasting work to make good calls on it.

  • Own the technical-product detail, setting clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform, and designing for the edge cases and operational reality of a system carrying live financial risk.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close - yours and the team's - so delivery keeps moving at pace, with a clear Now, Next and Future for the initiatives you own.

🚀 Responsibilities:

Turn needs into shipped product

  • Take business and customer needs and turn them into feasible product execution, balancing them against nascent ML and forecasting innovations that push the frontier of what's possible.

  • Take initiatives from discovery through to regularly released product, with a clear Now, Next and Future for a given area.

  • Drive open product decisions to a close, so work keeps moving.

  • Decide what to formalise, what stays a prototype and what to drop - be the editor and builder, not just the instigator.

Own the technical-product detail

  • Work embedded in full-stack teams that include ML/data science and software engineers, close enough to the models to make good calls.

  • Set clear success criteria for how well a model or forecast needs to perform for the product to work, and design for the edge cases and operational reality of a system that carries live financial risk.

  • Pull and interrogate your own and others' data to influence and inform decisions, and reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Get close to the people who use what you build, from internal commercial teams to generators and businesses externally.

Win in the portfolio

  • Concentrate, in the near term, on the portfolio area while it's still forming, without that becoming a permanent boundary on where you work.

  • Treat hedging, imbalance and trading decisions as product decisions: when to hold a position, when to trade it out, when to reprice to close a gap in the portfolio.

  • Find the tangible and most pressing problems worth solving - such as whether to buy or build a new forecasting capability, or how to ensure Rosso reacts at scale to any event in the system.

  • Chase the commercial outcome, not just the shipped feature - the measure of this role is margin found and risk managed, at pace.

🎯 Requirements:

Must haves

  • A product manager with real product execution behind them: owned at least one complex product area end to end, with a track record of moving real business outcomes, not just shipping features.

  • Commercial drive. You set the pace for yourself and the people around you, push decisions to a close, and go after revenue and margin. You want to win, and it shows in how you work.

  • Experience in or around trading. Energy trading is the ideal, but financial trading, fintech, battery or EV trading all count - you understand positions, hedging and what it means for a system to carry live financial risk.

  • Uses data analysis throughout the product process, to validate ideas, progress work, and measure success.

  • ML-literate: has worked closely enough with ML and data science to make good calls on model-led products, and can reason about model performance and error as business indicators.

  • Built product in a startup, scaleup or other high-growth environment, with high personal ownership of an area.

  • A strong instinct for failure points, edge cases and the operational reality of a live system.

  • AI-native, AI-literate and AI-critical - you know where it helps and where it hurts.

  • A clear, structured communicator, especially in writing.

Bonus points

  • Hands-on energy trading experience - intraday, day-ahead, imbalance or battery optimisation.

  • Experience where forecasting or fulfilling a two-sided marketplace is central to the product.

  • Experience going through a third-party-access and/or international-expansion transition.

  • Experience with regulated industries and data-heavy products.

✨ Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive salary - our current band for this role is £85,000-£93,000 or equivalent in local currency.

  • Stock Options - everyone on the team has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday + public holidays - Swap public holidays for ones that matter most to you. Plus, get an extra day off for your birthday 🎉.

  • Remote & flexible working - We're fully remote with clear core hours, and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Home working & wellbeing budgets:

    • Up to £1,200 / €1,200 annually to upgrade your remote setup (co-working passes, equipment, etc.).

    • Up to £150 / €150 monthly on anything that supports your wellbeing - from therapy to gym memberships to meditation apps.

 

🗣️ Interview Process:

Our processes normally take around 2-3 weeks from first call to offer - please let us know about any adjustments to timelines that may be required.

  1. First call with our Talent Team (30 Mins). This is to understand your experience, motivations, and discuss the role in more detail.

  2. Behaviour Interview with our Product Lead (45 Mins). This is your chance to really understand the role, the expectations, and ensure alignment on ways of working.

  3. Technical Interview with the Team (75 Mins). You’ll meet with potential peers to discuss how you drive product execution, work closely with ML and engineering teams, and think through real product scenarios - built around a real product decision shaped by a model or forecast, so we're testing on proof, not assertion.

  4. Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders (45 Mins). The final session will be with two cross-functional stakeholders, and will explore how your values align with ours, and is designed to be a genuine two-way conversation, your chance to understand what it’s really like to work at tem.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

descriptionHtml:

Bonus tacos if you have

  • Experience collaborating closely with Account Executives in an enterprise sales motion

About Coder

Coder is the leading platform for AI development Infrastructure, enabling enterprises to securely run human and AI-driven development workflows in consistent, governed environments. With Coder, enterprises can confidently evolve from human-only development to AI-assisted and autonomous workflows, without sacrificing security, compliance, or performance. Learn more at coder.com.

Interview process 

We believe that the interview process should be transparent, consistent, and enjoyable. We value your time and hope to complete the interview process in two to four weeks, if schedules allow. Through your interviews, you will meet a mix of individual contributors, managers, and senior leaders.

AI use during the interview process

As an AI company, Coder embraces the use of AI tools, and we want to be transparent about our expectations as you navigate our interview process.

Not permitted: Using AI assistance during conversational interviews.

Permitted: Using AI tooling for take-home assessments. Please flag where and to what extent it was used in your take-home. Your submission will not be penalized for using AI as long as it is done honestly.

All hiring decisions are made by humans. Our team reviews applications, conducts interviews, and makes final selections. AI tools assist us but never replace human judgment, and these practices are conducted in compliance with applicable data protection, AI governance, and labor laws. Your data is not used to train AI models.

title: Senior Scientist, Small Molecules
descriptionHtml:
About Boltz

Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.

Boltz began as an MIT spin-out. Our founders built Boltz-1 at MIT, and it became the first fully open-source model to match AlphaFold 3's accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.

We focus on two things:

  • Open foundation models. Boltz-1, Boltz-2, and BoltzGen are open models trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations.

  • Boltz Lab. Our commercial platform runs our latest models and design agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules, while we provide the compute, infrastructure, and collaboration layer so their scientists can move faster.

The two feed each other: open-source adoption earns scientific credibility and community insight, and Boltz Lab turns that into real impact on our partners' discovery programs.

You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our manifesto.

About the role

As a Scientist in Small Molecules, you will own the computational chemistry and molecular data analysis behind our small-molecule work, for partners' discovery programs and our own models. Good models start with well-understood data, and this role decides what our small-molecule models learn from and how we judge them.

You will work closely with external pharma and biotech partners, ML Research, and our Senior Scientist, ADME/DMPK.

This role is ideal for a computational chemist who builds their own tools, enjoys exploratory science, and wants analyses to change both research roadmaps and real discovery decisions.

What you'll do

  • Apply Boltz models on partner programs and help partners prepare, analyze and interpret their molecular and experimental data.

  • Standardize and integrate structures, protein–ligand complexes, binding and screening measurements into scientifically meaningful training and evaluation datasets.

  • Investigate open questions: map library diversity, cluster millions of generated compounds, compare performance across protein families or chemical series, find train–test leakage.

  • Build the scientific tooling these analyses need, in clean, reusable Python.

  • Diagnose where and why our models fail, and turn the findings into guidance for ML Research and our roadmap.

About you

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD or equivalent experience in computational chemistry, cheminformatics, chemical biology, structural bioinformatics or a closely related field.

  • Strong Python and RDKit (or similar), with practical experience in fingerprints, similarity search, clustering, scaffold analysis, dimensionality reduction and chemical-space visualization.

  • Deep understanding of small-molecule chemistry (series, stereochemistry, protonation and tautomers, scaffolds) and comfort with protein–ligand structural data.

  • Solid grasp of binding and screening data (KD, Ki, IC50, EC50), including assay context, uncertainty, censoring and comparability.

  • Clear communication of complex analyses to partners, ML researchers and chemists.

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience on real discovery programs: virtual screening, hit discovery, hit-to-lead or lead optimization; molecular ML such as affinity or property prediction.

  • Experience with large chemical libraries or model-generated compound sets, or pharma partnerships.

  • Experience using Boltz models, or open-source scientific software contributions.

We know great people don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you meet most of the minimum requirements, we'd like to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Ownership of the datasets and analyses our small-molecule models depend on, used by leading discovery teams.

  • Work alongside one of the most talent-dense teams in the field.

  • Significant ownership and independence, with responsibility for driving projects from concept to deployment.

  • Highly competitive salary with meaningful equity in a public benefit company.

  • Benefits:

    • 25 days plus bank holidays a year

    • Annual team offsite trip

    • Private healthcare (BUPA), covering pre-existing conditions

    • Pension program

    • Paid parental leave

    • Wellhub gym membership

    • Free lunch every day

    • Travel expenses

How we hire

  1. Initial screen with a member of the Talent team

  2. Technical interview

  3. Onsite in London with the team

  4. Offer + Onboarding

Our commitment

Boltz is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the hiring process, tell us and we'll make it work.
