title: Senior Security Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you'll be doing
This role does the hands-on architecture work. You design the secure patterns engineering builds against, review hard problems in depth, and help make secure-by-design real across the Hyperblock and Polaris platform and the AI product surface. You work closely with the Principal Security Architect, who sets the technical bar. You own significant areas of that work and deliver them end to end. Engineers adopt good architecture because it is the better path. You will build that kind of architecture, working on problems that carry real risk.

Anaplan is not a simple SaaS application. The platform performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modelling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. The technical surface includes the legacy Hyperblock engine, the newer Polaris engine, and a growing set of AI products. These include CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational planning support.

Enterprise customers in regulated industries increasingly ask a hard question: if Anaplan is breached, can Anaplan staff or an attacker read their data? Answering it takes rigorous architecture work. We are commissioning an independent Trail of Bits assessment of exactly this. It covers end-to-end tenant isolation, the proposed BYOK design, and internal infrastructure boundaries. You will help turn findings like these into concrete design changes. That includes moving key management from legacy HSM-based designs to Vault, and extending encryption coverage to storage and data paths that lack an agreed architecture today.

What you'll do
• Produce reference architectures: design and maintain security patterns for platform and AI components, working to the standards set by the Principal.
• Contribute to identity and authorisation design: including tenant isolation, service-to-service trust, and authorisation for AI agents and analyst-style workflows.
• Apply cryptography and key management: work on encryption, BYOK and key custody. Be clear about where data is plaintext, who can use keys, and what each control protects against.
• Design AI guardrails: input and output controls, tool and authorisation boundaries, and prompt-injection and abuse defences. Draw on MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP LLM Top 10.
• Run threat models: lead them on high-risk systems, working with engineers to trace trust boundaries and compromise paths. Turn the findings into prioritised, actionable design changes.
• Support external assessments: prepare architecture evidence, join discovery sessions with engineering, and check that what is built matches what is documented.
• Improve the supply chain and attack surface: build integrity and provenance, hardened images, and less exposed surface.
• Stay hands-on: write and review designs and prototypes, and test your own work.
• Grow the practice: mentor engineers, contribute to standards, and help turn design decisions into enforceable guidance.

What we're looking for
• Solid experience in secure software architecture, with depth in at least two of: cryptography and key management, identity and authorisation, tenant isolation, and threat modelling.
• A working understanding of AI and ML security, and of how LLM-driven features change identity, authorisation, supply chain, and verification.
• The ability to design and review real systems, and to defend your decisions to strong engineers.
• A record of influencing engineers without formal authority, including when risk and delivery pressure conflict.
• Experience with enterprise-scale SaaS or cloud-first systems, ideally multi-tenant.
• Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain architecture honestly to engineers, leadership, and customers.

Nice to have
• Experience with Vault, KMS/HSM, or BYOK/HYOK designs.
• Experience designing for regulated environments, such as FedRAMP.
• Contributions to NIST, ISO, or OWASP, or talks and published research.
• An offensive grounding that you use to pressure-test designs.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Senior Sensor Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Senior Sensor Engineer (Tactile & Proprioception) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will build the neural architecture of physical touch and spatial awareness that gives our robotic hands human-like dexterity.

You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines.

Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control.

What you will do:

  • Own the sensing architecture. Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype.

  • Develop tactile array hardware. Design and prototype high-resolution tactile sensors (optical, capacitive, piezoresistive, or magnetic) tailored for space-constrained, contact-rich finger pads and palm surfaces.

  • Engineer proprioceptive feedback. Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking.

  • Design readout electronics & AFEs. Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI).

  • Build calibration & processing pipelines. Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack.

  • Characterize & validate on real hardware. Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles.

  • Drive sensor manufacturing & yield. Partner with specialized suppliers on Design for Manufacturing (DFM) for flexible/rigid-flex PCBs, molded tactile skins, and elastomeric components, ensuring high assembly yield and second-sourcing.

  • Work across the whole team. Tight loop with Mechanics (for load paths and physical packaging), Electronics (for board interfaces), and Software (for state estimation and closed-loop grasp control).

What you bring:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Sensorics, Robotics, or a related field.

  • 5–10 years of experience developing sensor hardware, mechatronic instrumentation, or sensor fusion systems, including at least one product taken into series production.

  • Deep domain expertise in tactile sensing modalities (e.g., optical tactile/GelSight style, piezoresistive, capacitive) or high-density proprioceptive feedback (encoders, strain gauges, load cells).

  • Proven experience in analog circuit design, signal conditioning (AFE), active filtering, and high-SNR data acquisition for physical sensors.

  • Hands-on experience with sensor calibration techniques, thermal/hysteresis modeling, signal processing, and standard communication buses (SPI, I2C, CAN).

  • Practical experience designing or integrating flexible PCBs, molded elastomers, or miniaturized mechatronic assemblies into tight physical envelopes.

  • A strong hardware mindset: you enjoy lab bring-up, sensor characterization on test rigs, and tracing physics-to-signal anomalies with scopes and logic analyzers.

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus, not a requirement.

Bonus:

  • Background in real-time embedded C/C++ firmware or ROS/ROS2 for sensor data processing and filtering.

  • Experience with tactile algorithms for slip prediction, texture recognition, or contact shape estimation.

  • Experience with soft robotics, stretchable electronics, or conductive polymers.

  • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO/TS 15066, and sensor design for collaborative applications.

The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.

At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability, and robustness they need to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.

The technology is taking shape. The team is being built. And the standards for robotic hands and their skills are still wide open.

descriptionHtml:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Token Factory is a part of  Nebius Cloud, one of the world’s largest GPU clouds, running tens of thousands of GPUs. We are building an inference platform that makes every kind of foundation model — text, vision, audio, and emerging multimodal architectures — fast, reliable, and effortless to deploy at massive scale. To deliver on that promise, we need an engineer who can make the platform behave flawlessly under extreme load and recover gracefully when the unexpected happens.

In this role you will own the reliability, performance, and observability of the entire inference stack. Your day starts with designing and refining telemetry pipelines — metrics, logs, and traces that turn hundreds of terabytes of signal into clear, actionable insight. From there you might tune Kubernetes autoscalers to squeeze more efficiency out of GPUs, craft Terraform modules that bake resilience into every new cluster, or harden our request-routing and retry logic so even transient failures go unnoticed by users. When incidents do arise, you’ll rely on the automation and runbooks you helped create to detect, isolate, and remediate problems in minutes, then drive the post-mortem culture that prevents recurrence. All of this effort points toward a single goal: scaling the platform smoothly while hitting aggressive cost and reliability targets.

Success in the role calls for deep fluency with Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, Terraform, and the craft of infrastructure-as-code. You script comfortably in Python or Bash, understand the nuances of alert design and SLOs for high-throughput APIs, and have spent enough time in production to know how distributed back-ends fail in the real world. Experience shepherding GPU-heavy workloads — whether with vLLM, Triton, Ray, or another accelerator stack — will serve you well, as will a background in MLOps or model-hosting platforms. Above all, you care about building self-healing systems, thrive on debugging performance from kernel to application layer, and enjoy collaborating with software engineers to turn reliability into a feature users never have to think about.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build.

You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air.

  • Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand.

  • System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery.

  • HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements.

  • Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL.

  • HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks.


  • 4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least one closed-loop rig you designed and built yourself, not only operated or wrote test cases for

  • Real-time simulation coupled to hardware: plant and sensor models running in real time against real hardware, on commercial HIL platforms or custom Linux-based rigs

  • Expert Python, plus C or C++ for real-time components

  • Strong Linux and CI: self-hosted runners with hardware in the loop, containerised test environments, device management, remote power and console control

  • Debugging across the hardware and software boundary: embedded interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI and Ethernet, and timing problems you have measured, not guessed

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to haves

  • Flight or vehicle dynamics models, and PX4 or ArduPilot SITL/HITL

  • HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI PXI/VeriStand or Speedgoat

  • Sensor stimulation at the hardware interface: IMU, GNSS, camera and video injection

  • Time synchronisation (e.g. PTP), real-time Linux and jitter measurement

  • Test frameworks at scale (pytest or Robot Framework) and instrument control via SCPI or VISA

  • FMI/FMU or Gazebo-based simulation

  • MAVLink and flight controller interfaces

  • GNSS simulators (e.g. Spirent, Safran Skydel) and RF environment simulation

  • Camera and image generation pipelines for perception testing

  • Requirements-based testing in DO-178C or ISO 26262 contexts

  • Rust for performance-critical test components

  • Firmware for test fixtures on microcontrollers

  • End-of-line test stations

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.


We're looking for seasoned Product Designers who thrive in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

You'll be embedded in a product squad alongside a product manager and around three to five engineers, owning the user experience for your area end to end. Our design team is small but growing, so you'll shape the craft bar and the culture, not inherit them.

We're hiring designers across the following teams:

  • Enterprise (two roles - Governance & Observability, and Licence & Billing): You've worked on technical B2B platforms. You've designed for scale, governance, and collaboration across teams, including permissions, environments, observability, and failure modes included and you're comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • Adore - Adoption & Retention: You have exceptional product sense and can connect disparate elements into a coherent whole. You'll take something complex, with many moving parts, and make it make sense - shaping what the visual layer of n8n becomes next. Experience with data visualisation is welcome; deep technical expertise isn't required.

  • n8n Labs: As a Product Designer, you'll own discovery end-to-end, spotting the riskiest assumptions, running the research, and turning findings into decisions without waiting on a brief. You move fast, cut scope without losing what matters, and you're hands-on enough to build and ship your own prototypes, including using AI tools to get there quicker. You've got product and business judgment, not just craft; you can spot an opportunity and make the case for it. Founder or co-founder experience is a helpful signal but not a requirement.

Team assignment is confirmed at the offer stage and may be subject to change as the team structure evolves.

🎯 Regardless of the team, your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n's user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features and understand the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Own the direction of research for your team, decide when it's needed, choose the right methodology, and take the initiative without waiting to be told.

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates' work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product's big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Senior or Staff?

We're open at both levels, and we'll calibrate with you during the process. At Senior, you own your squad's design end-to-end and ship work that raises the bar for your area. At Staff, you do that, and your influence reaches beyond your own squad - you shape patterns other designers build on, and you take on the problems that span teams. Both are hands-on: this is not a step away from the craft.


REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You're proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies. You don't need to write code, but you do need genuine curiosity about what's happening underneath - APIs, webhooks, data structures and how workflows actually execute.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You've shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You're open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team's bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You're enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.


Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, with or without AI coding tools, and can collaborate effectively with engineers on the result.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You've designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You're comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You've built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.


Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a slide deck. You'll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces, shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise governance and billing, and how people discover and adopt n8n, from discovery to delivery. You'll join a fast-growing, Europe remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

title: Senior Structural Analysis Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Pangea Propulsion:

We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade.

We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology.

We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry.

We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer in Toulouse.

About the role:

As a Structural Analysis Engineer, you will be a key technical contributor within Pangea Propulsion’s Structural Analysis team, operating with autonomy on thermomechanical, dynamic, and nonlinear structural problems.

You will own analysis campaigns end-to-end: from problem framing, modelling, validation, to results interpretation and design recommendations - directly influencing the architecture, performance, and robustness of the next generation of propulsion systems.

Within the team, you will serve as a technical reference point for advanced structural analysis methods, help shape internal best practices, and elevate the quality of analyses across projects.

A core part of your role will be coaching and guiding junior and consolidated analysts, transferring knowledge, reviewing technical work, and contributing to a high-performance engineering culture.

In this position, you will also take ownership of complex structural analysis problems and contribute to defining modelling strategies and analysis standards for the team.

Familiarity with rocket propulsion hardware - or strong motivation to learn - will allow you to make an immediate impact.

Key responsibilities

· Perform and lead FEA campaigns including static, modal, thermo-mechanical, dynamic and transient analyses, dealing efficiently with non-linear problems (contacts, plasticity, large deformation etc.)

· Plan, build, verify, document and maintain high-fidelity and robust FE models with traceability to loads, material properties, requirements, and assumptions.

· Provide clear, high-impact design feedback to mechanical design and propulsion teams at both part and subsystem level.

· Develop and improve analysis methodologies, scripts, subroutines, benchmarks, and guidelines.

· Lead cross disciplinary interactions with mechanical design, fluidic analysis, and test teams to ensure coherent modelling strategies and proper load mapping.

· Participate in design reviews, presenting methods, assumptions, results, and recommendations with clarity, conciseness and technical rigor.

· Mentor junior and consolidated engineers, helping them develop modelling skills, physics intuition, validation strategies, and efficient workflows.

· Review and challenge analysis approaches to ensure modelling robustness and consistency across projects.

What you need to be successful

· Experience in the aviation or space industry is strongly preferred.

· Master’s degree (or higher) in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering disciplines.

· Minimum 5+ years of professional experience performing advanced structural analyses using commercial FEA tools (preferably Abaqus).

· Proven ability to run non-linear, thermo-mechanical, and dynamic analyses with a high level of autonomy and technical ownership.

· Strong understanding of structural mechanics, vibrations, fatigue, fracture, material behavior, and numerical methods.

· Demonstrated experience framing analysis problems, defining assumptions, and ensuring consistency with loads and system requirements.

· Ability to interpret results critically, identify anomalies, and propose sound engineering solutions.

· Excellent communication skills—able to articulate assumptions, limitations, and design implications clearly to multidisciplinary teams.

· Proactive mindset, ownership attitude, and passion for sharing knowledge and elevating team capability.

· Fluent English.

Other useful skills

· Experience in any of the following topics: fatigue (high cycle and low cycle), fracture mechanics, rotodynamics, test-correlation, topology optimization or probabilistic structural methods.

· Knowledge of rocket propulsion systems: injector heads, thrust chambers, turbomachinery, feed systems, thermal & dynamic environments, etc.

· Proficiency with meshing tools (e.g., MeshWorks) and scripting languages (Python, MATLAB).

· Experience writing Abaqus subroutines (UMAT, USDFLD, UEL, etc.).

· Experience working with ECSS, AIAA and other aerospace structural verification standards.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Aerospace, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions.

Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values.

Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

As we bring together our global operations, we are creating a unified approach to sustainability that supports our business objectives, strengthens ESG performance, and responds to growing customer and stakeholder expectations.

A key focus of the strategy is accelerating our decarbonisation journey through robust emissions management, science-based target implementation, and enhanced disclosure of our environmental performance, so we are looking for an experienced, proactive and driven Senior Sustainability Manager to become a key member of Kinly's sustainability function.

Key responsibilities:

  • Reporting to the VP Global Sustainability, this role will be vital in shaping and delivering Kinly's climate and circularity agenda while contributing to the broader development and implementation of the Group's sustainability strategy; so this will combine technical expertise with the ability to engage stakeholders across the business, translating sustainability ambitions into practical actions that deliver measurable environmental impact and support long-term business success.

  • Drive the development and implementation of Kinly's global decarbonisation programme, including coordination of emissions reduction initiatives and alignment with science-based targets.

  • Manage the annual collection, validation and analysis of Scope 1, 2 and 3 greenhouse gas emissions data across the organisation. Support external assurance and verification activities.

  • Contribute to climate-related assessments, including climate scenario analysis and the financial assessment of climate risks and opportunities.

  • Manage the revalidation of Kinly’s emissions reduction targets through the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), reflecting the expanded Group boundary following recent merger activities.

  • Drive resource efficiency and circular economy initiatives across client projects, working closely with operational and commercial teams.

  • Contribute to environmental and climate-related data collection and standard setting within the supply chain, in close collaboration with procurement.

  • Support external disclosures such as CDP, EcoVadis and sustainability reporting.

  • Monitor emerging sustainability regulations, reporting requirements and industry best practices relevant to climate and circularity.

Essential skills and experience:

  • Proven experience in environmental management, carbon accounting, corporate sustainability or a related field.

  • Proven experience supporting science-based target implementation or corporate decarbonisation programmes.

  • Strong understanding of greenhouse gas accounting principles, including Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions and the GHG Protocol.

  • Strong knowledge of climate target-setting and disclosure frameworks, particularly SBTi and CDP, with familiarity with TCFD-aligned climate reporting.

  • Understanding of circular economy principles, product lifecycle impacts and resource efficiency initiatives.

  • Analytical and quantitative skills, with advanced proficiency in Excel and experience using carbon accounting platforms.

  • Experience engaging with cross-functional stakeholders to drive sustainability outcomes.

  • Ability to communicate complex sustainability topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

title: Senior Tech Recruiter 360° (m/w/d), remote
descriptionHtml:
Unser Manifesto:

Beende das Glücksspiel im Tech-Recruiting

Hand aufs Herz: Die Branche ist kaputt. Die meisten Recruiter agieren als Bittsteller. Sie spammen hunderte Kandidaten an, hoffen auf eine Antwort und beten, dass der Kunde den Lebenslauf akzeptiert. Das Ergebnis? Frustrierte Kunden, genervte Talente und eine Platzierungsquote des Grauens.

Wir bei Recruitment Circle lehnen dieses Modell ab.

Wir sind keine Postboten.

Wir sind 360-Grad-Recruiter.

Was 360 Grad bei uns heißt

Du führst einen eigenen Desk. Vom ersten Anruf beim Kunden bis zur Unterschrift des Kandidaten liegt alles in einer Hand. In deiner.

  • Kunden gewinnen: Du sprichst CTOs, Practice Leads und Gründer selbst an, pitchst, machst das Angebot und verhandelst die Konditionen.
  • Kunden entwickeln: Du startest mit Bestandskunden und machst aus einer besetzten Rolle die nächste. Dein Buch gehört dir.
  • Kandidaten finden: Briefing, Boolean, Telefon und Active Sourcing bleiben bei dir.
  • Abschließen: Du führst beide Seiten durch Interviews, Angebot und Verhandlung, bis der Vertrag unterschrieben ist.

Wer nur Lebensläufe schieben will, wird hier nicht glücklich. Wer gerne verkauft, verdient hier doppelt.

Warum wir einzigartig sind

  • Einladungsquote von 60 bis 70 %: Der Markt liegt bei 10 bis 20 %. Bei uns werden rund zwei von drei eingereichten Kandidaten von Kunden wie SVA, Adesso oder FormlyAI zum Interview eingeladen. Warum? Weil wir tiefer graben. Auf deinem Desk führst du das Briefing selbst und weißt deshalb genau, wen der Kunde braucht.
  • Die RC-E-Learning Masterclass: Du hast Zugriff auf unser proprietäres Wissen. Wir bilden dich zum High-Performance Recruiter aus, der auf Augenhöhe mit CTOs und Practice Leads verhandelt.
  • Qualität als Identität: Wir identifizieren uns mit unserer Arbeit. Wenn wir eine Stelle besetzen, dann bleibt dieser Mensch dort und performt. Das ist unser Stolz. Und der Grund, warum Kunden mit der nächsten Rolle wieder zu dir kommen.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission: Die 12-Monats-Outcomes

Wir messen Erfolg nicht an der Zeit am Schreibtisch. Wir messen ihn am Umsatz deines Desks, an der Time-to-Fill und an den Kunden, die du gewinnst und hältst.

  • Monat 1: Du hast die ersten 3 Accounts übernommen, steuerst die Prozesse autark und hast deine Zielkundenliste für die Akquise stehen.
  • Monat 2 bis 3: Deine erste eigenständige Vermittlung ist unter Dach und Fach. Parallel führst du jede Woche Gespräche mit möglichen Neukunden.
  • Monat 6 (Probezeit-Finale): Du hast 120.000 € Revenue generiert, durch exzellentes Account Management 2 neue Projekte aus deinem Bestand heraus entwickelt und deinen ersten eigenen Kunden gewonnen.
  • Monat 12: Du stehst bei mindestens 250.000 € Jahresumsatz. Ein Teil davon kommt von Kunden, die du selbst geholt hast.

Dein Alltag auf dem 360-Grad-Desk

  • Akquise: Du rufst Zielkunden an, nutzt Job-Signale und Empfehlungen als Anlass und holst das Mandat.
  • Briefing und Angebot: Du führst das Rollenbriefing, machst das Angebot und verhandelst die Konditionen.
  • Suche: Du arbeitest im eigenen Bestand, mit Boolean auf LinkedIn und XING und am Telefon.
  • Kandidatenführung: Du bereitest Interviews vor, holst Feedback ein und verhandelst das Angebot bis zur Unterschrift.
  • Account Management: Du legst dem Kunden Zahlen, Daten und Fakten vor, steuerst nach und fragst nach der nächsten Rolle und nach Empfehlungen.

Du führst deinen Desk wie dein eigenes Geschäft.

Qualifikation

Wer du bist (The A-Player Profile)

Wir suchen keine „Sachbearbeiter“ und keine reinen Sourcer. Wir suchen High-Performance Headhunter, die beide Seiten können.

  • 360-Grad-Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre in einer Personalberatung oder Agentur gearbeitet und dort Kunden und Kandidaten verantwortet.
  • Sales: Du greifst gern zum Telefon, gewinnst Kunden kalt und über Empfehlungen und kannst ein Honorar verteidigen.
  • Sourcing: Du beherrschst Boolean und nutzt LinkedIn Automation, Clay, GitHub oder Stack Overflow als Hebel, um passive Talente zu finden, die niemand sonst erreicht.
  • Status-Autorität: Du sprichst mit Practice Leads und C-Level auf Augenhöhe, im Pitch genauso wie im Briefing. Du bist kein Bittsteller, du bist der Experte.
  • Extreme Ownership: Ein schweres Profil oder ein Nein vom Kunden ist für dich kein Grund aufzugeben, sondern eine Challenge, die du gewinnst.

Wenn du reine Delivery suchst und Kundengewinnung als Aufgabe von anderen siehst, passt diese Stelle nicht zu dir.

Benefits

Deine Perks

  • Aggressives Provisionsmodell: Du partizipierst direkt am Erfolg deines Desks. 5 bis 20 % Provision vom ersten Euro an, ungedeckelt. Auf Umsatz mit Kunden, die du selbst gewinnst, kommen nochmal 10 % oben drauf.
  • Dein Buch gehört dir: Du übernimmst Bestandskunden und gewinnst eigene dazu. Dein Desk wächst durch deine Kunden.
  • Warme Anlässe statt Blindflug: Job-Signale von Zielkunden und aus Wettbewerber-Boards kommen als Digest. Lead-Listen und Erstansprache laufen als Sequenz. Den Aufhänger liefert das System. Den Anruf machst du.
  • High-End Tech-Stack: Du nutzt Recruit CRM, Clay, Juicebox und unsere eigenen Automatisierungs-Workflows, in der Suche wie in der Akquise. Die Werkzeuge nehmen dir Routine ab. Das Handwerk bleibt bei dir.
  • Radical Candor und Teamship: Wir kämpfen füreinander. Wenn ein Prozess stockt, sprechen wir es sofort an. Brutal ehrlich, aber immer mit dem Ziel, das Team besser zu machen. Keine Politik. Nur Ergebnisse.

„Wir bauen keine Datenbanken. Wir bauen Karrieren und die Marktführer von morgen.“

Und du baust dir bei uns deinen eigenen Desk mit eigenen Kunden.

title: Senior Vascular Sonographer
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are growing our vascular team and building out the follow-up pathway that sits behind the Neko Body Scan. When a scan raises a vascular flag, such as a low ankle-brachial index, a difference in blood pressure between the arms, or asymmetry on our Spectrum Gen 2 imaging, a member is referred for a follow-up examination. You will carry out those examinations.

This is a senior role within a small, close team. You will scan and report your findings, work closely with our Vascular Specialist, who makes the clinical decisions and referrals, and help shape how the pathway runs as it scales. You will also be a vascular reference point for the doctors and operators who perform first-line measurements in our clinics.

What you will do

  • Perform and report arterial duplex ultrasound of the lower and upper limbs for members referred through the vascular follow-up pathway.

  • Carry out repeat ankle-brachial pressure index (ABPI) with Doppler, and toe pressures or toe-brachial index where the pathway calls for them.

  • Carry out the examination requested through the pathway, record your findings clearly and consistently, and report them to the Vascular Specialist, who decides the outcome and any onward referral.

  • Recognise findings that need urgent action, such as suspected critical or acute limb ischaemia, and escalate the same day through our agreed emergency pathway.

  • Flag it to the Vascular Specialist when a request does not fit what you find, explaining your reasoning, so they can decide the next step.

  • Support quality and pathway improvement: contribute to protocols and SOPs, take part in audit, and help us understand how well our thresholds and referral criteria perform in practice.

  • Maintain equipment, probe cleaning and infection control standards, and report faults promptly.

  • Where needed, cross-cover follow-up lists at our clinics in other cities, with notice and travel costs covered, so the pathway keeps running during leave and peaks in demand.

  • Uphold safeguarding, consent, confidentiality and information governance standards in all member contact.

What we are looking for

Essential

• Registered with the HCPC, or accredited as a vascular sonographer through a recognised route such as a CASE-accredited programme or the Register of Clinical Technologists [HR to confirm accepted routes].

• A recognised qualification in vascular ultrasound or vascular science (for example a postgraduate vascular ultrasound qualification or a clinical physiology degree with vascular specialism).

• Strong hands-on vascular ultrasound experience, with the ability to scan and report your findings accurately, or to reach that standard quickly with support from our team.

• Excellent communication. You explain what you are doing and finding clearly and kindly to members who may be anxious, and you pass on findings precisely to colleagues across clinical and non-clinical teams.

• Sound clinical awareness and the confidence to escalate. You recognise when a finding may be urgent and make sure the right person knows straight away. • Willingness to travel occasionally to cover our clinics in other cities. • Right to work in the UK

Desirable

  • Five or more years of experience, or experience supervising or training other clinicians in vascular technique.

  • Experience in a preventive, screening or private healthcare setting.

  • An interest in learning new vascular technologies.

  • Experience contributing to audit, service development or protocol writing.

  • Comfort working with digital clinical systems and structured reporting.

Working pattern

You will be based at our clinic in your city. We are hiring one vascular sonographer each in London, Manchester and Birmingham, and as a team you may occasionally be asked to cross cover another city. Cover is arranged in advance, and travel costs are covered.

  • Partner with creators and wellness influencers who authentically represent the Wellhub brand.

  • Guide decisions, constructively challenge requests, and resolve escalations while protecting local relevance and global brand consistency.
  • Collaborate with UK marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner teams to amplify locally relevant moments.Work closely with the global creative team to align content quality, storytelling, sonic identity, and brand voice.
  • Support country leaders and internal spokespeople with social content, thought leadership, and engagement guidance. 
  • Own Measurement Optimisation and Insights.
  • Track and report on performance metrics across awareness, engagement, growth, and sentiment.Test new formats, creative variations, and posting strategies to continuously improve results.
  • Conduct social listening to understand audience behavior and guide content direction.
  • Review performance across European markets with local social managers and turn shared learnings into regional recommendations and improvements.
  • Community Engagement and Brand Advocacy
  • Oversee proactive community management across the UK channels—engaging in conversations, responding to comments, and cultivating brand advocates.
  • Ensure alignment with global crisis and response protocols.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 7+ years of experience in social media, content creation, or digital marketing—ideally in fast-moving B2C or lifestyle brands.
  • You're fluent in UK social culture, humor, trends, and how different audiences behave online.
  • You have excellent English writing and editorial skills.
  • You're a video-first creator who is comfortable planning, shooting, editing—and occasionally stepping in front of the camera.
  • You're obsessed with social platforms: their algorithms, nuances, and emerging formats.
  • You understand how to speak to diverse audiences—consumers, HR leaders, corporate buyers, wellness partners.
  • You're highly creative, but also organized and able to manage calendars, workflows, approvals, and reporting.
  • You have experience managing and developing social media teams across markets, with the judgement and autonomy to serve as the senior regional lead.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team.

title: Software Engineer JVM
descriptionHtml:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

This role focuses on building performant, maintainable systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features that meet business and customer needs. You'll lead development of Pelico's ETL backend in Java, owning scalability and performance for the systems that turn complex, high-volume manufacturing data into a single live operational picture.

Your mission

  • Design, develop, and optimize Pelico's ETL backend components in Java, building scalable and efficient solutions for complex data processing

  • Architect scalable, modular services while ensuring data integrity, security, and availability across distributed environments

  • Integrate third-party services and APIs to extend platform capabilities, and collaborate with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies

  • Develop solutions for large-scale data ingestion, processing, and analysis, optimizing relational database interactions and distributed data systems

  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions, leading by example on Java best practices

  • Write clean, maintainable, testable code and drive unit, integration, and performance testing to guarantee system stability

What we're looking for

  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin (backend), with experience in relational databases and API development

Software Engineer

Office Location: Temple, London - Hybrid (3 days/week in office)

Experience Level: +3 years commercial software engineering experience

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that. Investa is the first FCA-regulated platform to offer completely free US share trading with no FX, no commission, and no other fees.

Our Traction So Far:

  • £3.5M+ raised in funding with 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • FCA-regulated and multi-award winning in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) & Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN)

  • Available on iOS and Android, scaling rapidly toward our next milestones of 10,000 and 100,000 active users

  • 8,000+ trades processed, 2,500+ early supporters rewarded, and 150+ 5-star reviews

Our Mission: To democratise options trading for UK investors

Our Vision: Think Options, Think Investa

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.

The Role

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch, and we’re now looking for a driven Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

Having passed the junior stage of your career, you bring over 3 years of commercial experience writing clean code and shipping features independently. In this role, you will take true end-to-end ownership of core platform features, work across our stack, and step outside your comfort zone to level up your technical depth alongside our talented engineering team of 4.

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex financial challenges and you excel in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we want to hear from you.

What the Role Involves

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders without corporate red tape, , you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

  • Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • System Design & Architectural Contribution: Partnering directly with the engineering team to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and components you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.

  • Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and contribute to) meaningful code reviews.

  • System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship

Your Background

  • Experience: +3 years of commercial software engineering experience, ideally with experience building or maintaining distributed systems or backend APIs.

  • Hands-on Coder: You are a strong practitioner who loves shipping clean, readable code and takes pride in seeing features go live.

  • Tech Stack Proficiency: Proficient in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go) and comfortable working within cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You understand the balance between elegant code and delivering real value to users in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Curious & First-Principles Thinker: You enjoy dissecting how systems work under the hood and are ready to quickly pick up domain concepts like options pricing, execution mechanics, and financial regulations.

On-call

All engineers at Investa participate in supporting our production applications. This involves responding to critical system events outside of working hours and ensuring our platform stays dependable.

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

Compensation and Benefits

Financial Growth 💸

  • Base Salary: £60,000 - £85,000 per annum, commensurate with experience.

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.2% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

  • Annual Review: Structured salary and performance reviews conducted every year to ensure your growth stays on track.

Health & Wellbeing 🌴🦷

  • Annual Leave: 30 days (including bank holidays) + your birthday off.

  • Premium Coverage: Private medical and dental insurance via Bupa.

Office Environment & Lifestyle ☕

  • The Office: Work from a vibrant, spacious office featuring a private gym and a rooftop terrace for fresh-air breaks.

  • Fuel & Socials: Enjoy tea, coffee and snacks daily. Every last Wednesday of the month, we host a Team Lunch where the menu is chosen by you. We also run regular team socials, alongside company and individual milestone celebrations.

Tech 💻

  • Custom Setup: You’ll receive a high-spec MacBook Pro and £150 toward a mouse and keyboard of your choice.

Interview Process

  • Stage 2: Technical & Architectural Deep Dive

title: Software Prototyping Engineer - N3XT (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role:
N3XT’s software engineers write the code that makes a prototype useful: autonomy behaviours, sensor data processing, AI models running on the edge, and the interfaces to Quantum Systems’ platforms and to MOSAIC. Your software runs on real hardware in the field, often within weeks of the first idea, and you work next to the hardware and embedded engineers who build the system around it.

We are hiring at junior and senior level. Senior engineers own the software architecture of a prototype and develop the people around them. Junior engineers take ownership of well-defined components and grow quickly through work on real systems.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Develop prototype software for autonomy, perception, sensor fusion, signal processing and mission functions.

  • Deploy and optimise AI and computer vision models on edge compute such as NVIDIA Jetson, within real size, weight and power limits.

  • Integrate sensors and payloads in software: drivers, data pipelines, time synchronisation and calibration.

  • Connect prototypes to Quantum Systems platforms and to MOSAIC through clean interfaces: APIs, middleware and message protocols.

  • Build simulation, test and data-logging tools so that every field test produces usable data.

  • Join field tests and fix problems on site.

  • Write code that line engineering can take over: structured, tested and documented.

  • Senior level: define the software architecture of a prototype, make technology choices, review code and mentor junior engineers.


What you bring to the team:

  • Degree in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, physics or a related field.

  • Strong C++ and/or Python, and a Linux development environment.

  • Experience in at least one of our domains: Air, Land, Sea or Software.

  • Interest in software that runs on hardware, outside the data centre.

  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Business-fluent English. German is a strong advantage.

Strong adventage:

  • Defence experience, or a working understanding of how armed forces use unmanned systems and what is being built for them right now.

  • ROS 2, PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, DDS, GStreamer.

  • Processing radar, electronic warfare or signal intelligence data; software-defined radio (e.g. GNU Radio).

  • Model optimisation with CUDA or TensorRT.

  • Docker, CI/CD and automated testing for embedded targets.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

title: Softwaretester / QA Engineer als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mach aus guten Ideen Software, die im Alltag überzeugt

Du probierst neue Funktionen aus und merkst schnell, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft? Du willst Fehler verstehen, Lösungen mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team ein Produkt besser machen? Dann könnte das deine Rolle bei AUGLETICS sein.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren smarte Rudergeräte in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Bei uns siehst du direkt, wie deine Arbeit das Training unserer Kunden verbessert: Du testest am echten Gerät, arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung zusammen und begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Release.

Du ergänzt unser Softwareteam mit vier bis fünf Personen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Dein Schwerpunkt ist Softwarequalität. Dazu übernimmst du technische Projektkoordination: Du bringst Ordnung in offene Aufgaben, klärst Anforderungen und hilfst dem Team, Ideen zuverlässig umzusetzen. In diese Verantwortung kannst du hineinwachsen.

Das machst du bei uns

  • App und Gerät gründlich testen: Du prüfst neue Funktionen, typische Trainingsabläufe und Grenzfälle und gibst konkretes Feedback zu Funktion und Bedienbarkeit.

  • Tests aufbauen und verbessern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, Checklisten und wiederholbare Regressionstests. Schritt für Schritt baust du Testautomatisierung auf – immer dort, wo sie dem Produkt und dem Team hilft.

  • Fehler bis zur Lösung verfolgen: Du beschreibst reproduzierbare Schritte, grenzt Ursachen gemeinsam mit der Entwicklung ein und prüfst, ob eine Korrektur auch im Zusammenspiel mit anderen Funktionen funktioniert.

  • Projekte ins Ziel bringen: Du strukturierst Aufgaben, formulierst klare Abnahmekriterien, koordinierst Abhängigkeiten und machst Fortschritt und offene Fragen sichtbar.

  • Zusammenarbeit erleichtern: Du moderierst agile Abstimmungen, etwa aus Scrum oder Kanban, und hilfst, Hindernisse zu beseitigen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team entwickelst du Abläufe weiter, die zu uns passen.

  • KI praktisch nutzen: Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Testideen, Fehleranalyse, kleine Hilfsprogramme und Automatisierung ein und überprüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Interesse an Softwaretests, Qualitätssicherung und technischen Projekten. Erste Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung – auch ein eigener Lernweg oder die Motivation, dich neu in das Thema einzuarbeiten, interessieren uns.

  • Freude daran, genau hinzuschauen und Probleme systematisch zu lösen. Du kannst verständlich erklären, was nicht funktioniert und wie es sich nachstellen lässt.

  • Technisches Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von App, Gerät und Backend sowie Lust, dich tiefer einzuarbeiten.

  • Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du fragst nach, hältst offene Punkte nach und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte Entwicklung und Tests. Wenn du damit schon selbst experimentiert hast, zeig uns gern ein Beispiel.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich, um technische Themen im Team sicher zu besprechen und zu dokumentieren. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort in Königs Wusterhausen zu arbeiten: Viele Tests finden direkt am Rudergerät statt.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Android-Entwicklung, zum Beispiel mit Kotlin oder Java.

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps und dem Zusammenspiel von App, Benutzerkonten und gespeicherten Daten.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Erste Kenntnisse in Testautomatisierung, Git, CI/CD oder agiler Projektarbeit. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du anfassen und ausprobieren kannst, und viele Ideen, die wir gemeinsam in hoher Qualität umsetzen wollen.

  • Ein Team von rund 25 Mitarbeitenden, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Raum, fachlich zu wachsen und zunehmend Verantwortung für Qualität, Tests und Projektabläufe zu übernehmen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Beispielprojekt oder ein Testkonzept ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. The role focuses on hands-on software testing and quality assurance, with growing responsibility for project coordination. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

descriptionHtml:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes.
