title: Stage Styling
descriptionHtml:
Wij zijn op zoek naar een Stagiair Styling ter versterking van ons creatieve Styling team.

Ben jij creatief, zelfstandig en barst je van de ideeën? Dan is dit jouw kans om praktijkervaring op te doen in een omgeving waar creativiteit centraal staat. Bij ons krijg je de ruimte om je talent te laten zien én verder te ontwikkelen.

Tijdens deze stage werk je mee aan uiteenlopende stylingprojecten in binnen- en buitenland, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is. Je bent betrokken bij het stylen van onze showroom in Reeuwijk en zorgt er samen met het Styling- en Beurzenteam voor dat deze er ieder seizoen inspirerend en vernieuwend uitziet. Daarnaast ondersteun je bij (internationale) beurzen en denk je mee over de presentatie van onze collecties tot in de kleinste details.

Ook werk je samen met het Sales team aan merchandisingactiviteiten, zoals het inrichten van schappen en winkelpresentaties bij klanten. Zo krijg je een breed beeld van het vak en lever je een directe bijdrage aan hoe onze producten worden gepresenteerd.

We zoeken een enthousiaste en flexibele persoonlijkheid die creativiteit weet te combineren met een hands-on mentaliteit en oog voor detail. Reizen hoort bij deze stage, dus het is belangrijk dat je dat leuk vindt!


Wie zoeken wij?

Het belangrijkste vinden wij dat jij je verder wilt ontwikkelen binnen styling, een ‘hands-on mentaliteit’ hebt en er samen voor wilt zorgen om de styling naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je bent op zoek naar een stageplek vanaf 2027. Daarnaast:

  • MBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je volgt een vakopleiding gericht op styling en design;

  • Originaliteit, enthousiasme, stressbestendigheid, flexibiliteit en initiatief;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Zelfstandig en tevens een teamspeler.

In verband met de bereikbaarheid van ons kantoor in Reeuwijk is het handig als je in de omgeving woont of in het bezit bent van een eigen vervoermiddel. Edelman BV is met het Openbaar vervoer bereikbaar maar dan dien je nog 20 à 30 minuten te fietsen vanaf station CS Gouda of station CS Bodegraven.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Stage lopen bij Edelman betekent o.a.:

  • Een passende stagevergoeding;

  • Gratis sporten na werktijd;

  • Internationaal bedrijf met een goede werksfeer waar hard werken en fun samen gaan;

  • Leuke bedrijfsfeesten;

  • Korting op de aanschaf van onze producten;

  • Een leuke stage waarbij je met prachtige producten werkt!

Over Edelman:

Met een enthousiast team van 260 professionals ontwerpen, collectioneren en verkopen wij onze producten wereldwijd. Ons moderne hoofdkantoor en showroom is gevestigd in Reeuwijk.

Het productassortiment van Edelman wordt gekenmerkt door hoogwaardige producten van keramiek, glas en metaal. Edelman heeft een groot assortiment kerstartikelen, zoals kerstbomen van Triumph Tree & Black Box Trees, verlichting van Luca Lighting, ornamenten en de miniatuurwereld van Luville Collectables. Daarnaast biedt Edelman een uitgebreid assortiment woonaccessoires en kunstbloemen, woontextiel, seizoensartikelen, planten en bomen van Mica Decorations. Alles is verkrijgbaar in levendige kleuren en texturen.

Edelman is B-Corp gecertificeerd, bij Edelman zijn diversiteit, gelijkheid en inclusie drie belangrijke onderwerpen in de organisatie. Wij streven naar een omgeving, waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en zich gerespecteerd voelt. Daarnaast erkent Edelman dat diversiteit in perspectieven, achtergronden en ervaringen innovatie voedt en ons succes als team stimuleert.

title: Stage: Technische dienst
descriptionHtml:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdracht

Bij de Technische Dienst kun je 10 of 20 weken meelopen en krijg je de kans om de techniek achter onze productieprocessen van dichtbij te leren kennen. Je draait mee met de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en doet praktijkervaring op in een technische omgeving.

Tijdens je stage:

  • Loop je mee met de dagelijkse werkzaamheden van de Technische Dienst.

  • Ondersteun je bij onderhoud en technische werkzaamheden aan machines en installaties.

  • Leer je hoe technische storingen worden aangepakt.

  • Doe je praktijkervaring op met onderhoud, veiligheid en techniek binnen een productieomgeving.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.

Veiligheid tijdens je stage

Veiligheid staat ook tijdens de uitvoering van de stageopdracht voorop. Je voert daarom geen risicovolle onderhoudswerkzaamheden zelfstandig uit. Eventuele technische aanpassingen worden uitsluitend uitgevoerd door bevoegde medewerkers of externe partijen.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een mbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Mechatronica, of Service en onderhoud elektrotechniek en instrumentatie.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en proactief en communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s.

  • Je bent 32 tot 40 uur per week beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage

  • Je kunt zelfstandig naar onze locatie in Elsloo of Hoensbroek reizen.

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? title: Stagiaire Chargé de mission – Gouvernance des données H/F
department: DOPS - Centre de services transverses - Data
descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous rejoindrez le Centre de Services Data de la Direction des opérations (DOPS). Cette équipe transverse accompagne les programmes métiers de l’ANS dans la valorisation des données, pilote la plateforme data et l’Observatoire de la e-Santé et contribue à la diffusion de pratiques fiables de traitement et d’exploitation des données. Pour faciliter l’accès aux données, leur compréhension et leur utilisation par les équipes comme par les outils d’intelligence artificielle, le centre renforce sa gouvernance, ses processus et sa documentation. Vous participerez à l’évaluation des pratiques existantes et à la mise en œuvre d’améliorations concrètes.

🎯 Missions principales

Évaluer et faire évoluer la gouvernance des données

  • Auditer les processus de gouvernance existants et les comparer aux bonnes pratiques applicables aux plateformes Data.

  • Évaluer le niveau de maturité des processus, identifier les axes de renforcement et proposer de nouveaux dispositifs.

  • Contribuer à l’élaboration d’un plan d’évolution des pratiques, puis à la mise en œuvre des actions retenues.

Fiabiliser l’accès aux données et la documentation

  • Revoir et enrichir les documents existants, notamment le catalogue de données, et créer la documentation manquante.

  • Produire des supports facilitant la compréhension et l’identification des modèles de données, y compris par les outils d’IA générative.

  • Contribuer à l’étude visant à traduire des demandes formulées en langage naturel en requêtes SQL, puis formaliser le cadre de gouvernance dans des documents adaptés aux directions et aux équipes opérationnelles.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, dans un cursus en informatique, gestion des données ou systèmes d’information.

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.

  • Vous maîtrisez impérativement SQL et disposez de connaissances solides en modélisation des données et en cartographie des flux.

  • Vous avez idéalement une première expérience en assistance à la gestion de projet avec une dimension Data significative.

  • Vous êtes rigoureux·se, curieux·se et adaptable, avec de bonnes capacités de synthèse.

  • Vous savez rédiger des notes, guides et référentiels documentaires de qualité et êtes à l’aise à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

title: Strategic account executive, financial services (UK)
descriptionHtml:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Join WRITER's sales team as a strategic account executive and help shape the future of work. You'll empower global enterprises (8,000+ employees) to transform their operations through our cutting-edge AI agent platform, enabling organizations to deploy AI at scale and unlock unprecedented productivity. This isn't just about hitting quota – it's about becoming a trusted advisor to some of the world's most influential companies as they navigate their AI transformation journey.

This role is perfect for high performers who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environments where you have the autonomy to drive results and build lasting relationships with both clients and teammates. If you're energized by meaningful work, the opportunity to make a real impact, and the challenge of selling category-defining technology, we want to hear from you. You'll be selling solutions that fundamentally change how enterprises operate, working with executive buyers who are making multi-million dollar, multi-year commitments to AI transformation.

This is a hybrid role based out of our London hub. You'll be reporting to our regional vice president.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you need

  • 7-10+ years of quota-carrying strategic SaaS sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas in complex, value-based sales motions targeting Fortune 500 and Global 2000 financial services accounts

  • Deep understanding of the UK and European financial services landscape — banking, asset management, insurance, and fintech — including its regulatory environment, buying cycles, and communication standards

  • Demonstrated expertise in managing sophisticated enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement and security processes, and orchestrating cross-functional resources to drive deals through technical evaluations and executive approvals

  • Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to credibly engage with C-suite buyers (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, COOs), translate complex technical concepts into business value, and build authentic relationships based on trust and strategic insight

  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to conduct discovery that uncovers underlying business challenges, connects AI capabilities to measurable outcomes, and creates urgency around transformation initiatives in regulated industries

  • Experience in outbound prospecting, account mapping, and territory planning, with a hunter mentality that drives you to consistently create new opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for ownership — you thrive in fast-paced environments where you're expected to figure things out, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive your own success with minimal oversight

  • Deep alignment with WRITER's values: you naturally Connect across functions and build collaborative relationships, you Challenge the status quo and aren't afraid to have difficult conversations, and you Own your outcomes with accountability and a commitment to long-term impact

⭐️ Is this you?

  • You've sold into financial services institutions and understand what it takes to navigate complex, regulated buying environments — from security and compliance reviews to board-level approvals

  • You're a closer who has consistently carried and exceeded seven-figure quotas, and you can point to deals where you created the opportunity from scratch rather than working an inbound lead

  • You think like a consultant but sell like a hunter — your discovery uncovers pain buyers didn't know they had, and your storytelling connects AI to outcomes that matter to a CIO and a CFO alike

  • You understand the UK FS market specifically — the players, the regulators, the buying rhythms — and you have or can build a network that opens doors

  • You're comfortable in the boardroom and the back office — equally credible presenting an AI transformation vision to an exec team and working through the technical and procurement details with the people who sign off

  • You move fast, own your number, and don't wait to be told what to do next

Preferred skills

  • Existing network and relationships within UK or European financial services institutions

  • Background in management consulting, particularly with FS clients

  • Experience selling AI, data, or enterprise platform deals into regulated industries

  • Familiarity with the compliance, security, and governance requirements that shape FS buying decisions

  • Experience supporting or leading large-scale rollouts or change management programs

  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills for executive audiences

🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

  • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

  • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

  • Fertility and family planning support

  • Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri

  • Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

  • Annual work-life stipends for:

    • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

    • Learning and development stipend

  • Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

  • Competitive compensation and company stock options

title: Strategic Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
📍Manchester (Hybrid) | 💰 Basic £50k, realistic £100k OTE

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Join our Enterprise Sales team to drive new business growth across Spectre and Street.co.uk. With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning prospecting and CRM technology, you’ll have the opportunity to drive new business, close high-value deals, and play a key role in shaping the future of PropTech in the UK.

As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to spearhead enterprise-level sales, working closely with our VP of Sales to drive revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for prospecting, engaging, and closing high-value deals, selling to board-level stakeholders and securing strategic partnerships. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to multi-thread across complex organisations to drive adoption of our full product suite.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

A bit about you…

  • You have 2+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record in enterprise sales.

  • Enterprise sales strategy expertise, including account mapping, multi-threading, and engaging multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience in either Challenger, Gap Selling or PClub sales methodology, MEDDIC qualification methodology, forecasting, and ABM/ABS strategies.

  • Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers and close high-value deals.

  • Consultative sales approach, able to understand business challenges and position tailored solutions.

  • Resilience, confidence, and presence - you can hold the room, drive conversations, and articulate value effectively.

  • A team player mindset, working collaboratively across departments to drive success.

  • Coachability, always seeking to refine your approach and stay ahead in enterprise sales best practices.


Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Strategic Account Executive at Street Group

  • Executing ABM/ABS strategies, identifying and targeting key accounts with a structured approach.

  • Prospecting and outbound outreach, using cold calling, email, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities.

  • Managing and optimising CRM data, ensuring accurate tracking of leads, interactions, and progress.

  • Conducting research on industries, prospects, and competitors to craft personalised outreach.

  • Handling objections with confidence, positioning value-driven solutions tailored to client needs.

  • Collaborating with our Technical Pre-Sales team to map prospect workflows and demonstrate how Street transforms the way their agency operates end to end.

  • Developing strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within a business to drive engagement.

  • Becoming a product expert, understanding how our solutions solve industry challenges.

  • Refining sales processes and methodologies, working closely with leadership to enhance effectiveness.

  • Collaborating with sales, marketing, and a Strategic SDR to ensure seamless lead handoff, targeted outreach, and effective nurture strategies.

  • Continuously improving performance, embracing feedback, and adapting to new strategies and insights.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You've only ever done inside sales. This role is field-based, and roughly half your time is out with customers.

  • You need a fully qualified pipeline handed to you. Prospecting and pipeline generation are core to the role.

  • You're expecting a job where you can coast on existing relationships. We're hunting for new business into accounts we don't yet own.

  • You're looking for a fully remote role. We need you in the Manchester office a minimum of three days per week, every other week, and out with customers the rest of the time.

  • You think your product knowledge matters more than your ability to sell. We'll teach you the product; your commercial acumen is what we're hiring.


Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%!

Why join Street Group?

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Account Manager, you own the relationship with our customers across their entire lifecycle, working with some of our largest and most strategic accounts. Your job is to make sure customers get real, measurable value from Omnea from day one, and to turn that value into renewals, expansion, and upsell.

Omnea's product is sticky: it's a business transformation, not a point tool, so once a customer is live, expansion tends to follow. Your focus skews heavily toward that expansion motion, not just keeping accounts renewed.

You'll build deep, long-term relationships with your champions and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders at every level, from procurement managers up to CFOs. You'll be the internal voice of the customer, working closely with both technical and commercial teams to keep Omnea customer-centric at its core.

This is an early hire on the customer team, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe to build the function from the ground up. There's no fixed playbook yet: you'll help write it.

What You'll Do

  • Own a revenue number: You'll carry an NRR quota covering both expansion and retention across your enterprise book. That means proactively identifying upsell opportunities, running commercial conversations at exec level, and owning the renewal process end-to-end.

  • Build relationships that go all the way to the top: Your relationships will run from procurement managers to CFOs. You'll multi-thread across each account, building genuine trust across multiple stakeholders, and you'll be the person customers call when something goes wrong or when they're thinking about what's next.

  • Build the playbook from scratch: There's no fully built playbook yet - you'll help shape it. You'll work alongside an exceptional implementation team, product experts, and leadership that have scaled world-class companies to define the commercial rhythms, norms, and processes to set the standard as the function grows.

  • Shape what Omnea builds next: You're the closest person to what our customers will and won't pay for. You'll feed that signal directly to Product and Revenue leadership, surfacing what's blocking adoption, what's driving expansion, and where we should be investing.

What's Different About This Role

  • This isn't a traditional post-sale account management role. Omnea's product is a business transformation, not a point tool, so most of your quota comes from expansion, not just renewal.

  • We're not looking for a narrow "Account Manager" background. We want people from GTM roles broadly or from customer-facing roles with heavy commercial/GTM crossover.

  • There's no fully built playbook. You'll define the commercial rhythms and processes as you go, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe.

  • You'll be as close to the product roadmap as anyone outside Product itself: what you hear from customers directly shapes what gets built next.

About You

We don't expect you to know exactly how to do all of this when you join. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and skillset to take this on.

TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, and you instinctively know how to navigate complex organisations. You might come from a GTM role (sales, customer success, partnerships) or a customer-facing role with heavy GTM crossover. What matters is that you've worked in real enterprise environments, managed senior stakeholders with high expectations, and have a track record of getting things done.

  • 4-8 years of experience in a top-tier, fast-paced environment: a startup, scale-up, VC, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • If you've been in a commercial role, you've worked six-figure ARR+ accounts, navigated multi-stakeholder buying committees, and built genuine executive relationships

  • You build rapport, influence people, and drive change, whether with a distinguished exec or a junior operator. You have the gravitas to engage senior leadership, ideally up to CFOs, Legal, or Procurement

  • You're comfortable in ambiguity. You don't need a fully built playbook: you'll build it as you go and improve it as you learn. You're organised enough to manage a complex book of business without dropping anything, and confident enough to push back on customers when they're wrong

  • You're ambitious, competitive, and care about doing excellent work, with a track record of high performance in whatever you've turned your hand to: sales, academia, sport, or something of your own. You take ownership seriously, and you'd rather work hard on something meaningful than coast on something safe

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: System Architect
descriptionHtml:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

  • Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

  • Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

  • Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

  • Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

  • Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

  • Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

  • Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

  • MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

  • Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

  • Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

  • Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

  • Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

  • Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

  • Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

  • Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

  • Knowledge of data center power architectures.

  • Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

  • Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

We are seeking a strategic, people-focused Team Lead Functional Analyst to head our Functional Analysis & Process Design chapter within the Enterprise Applications & Integrations department. As tonies undergoes a company-wide transformation from a distributed landscape to a harmonized, global operating model powered by SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, our IT and business functions are moving toward a product-oriented organization.

In this pivotal role, you will provide horizontal leadership to our team of Functional Analysts -the vital translation bridge between our business value streams (Operations, Finance, Sales) and our technical delivery teams. The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of end-to-end business processes with a strong mentoring mindset, setting methodology standards and empowering the team to translate operational needs into scalable, standard-first enterprise solutions.

What you'll do

As Team Lead Functional Analyst, you will act as the Chapter Lead for Functional Analysis, providing both disciplinary leadership and methodological governance for your team.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Team Leadership & Development: Providing horizontal leadership to the Functional Analyst team, overseeing personal skill development, coaching, and managing capacity allocation across various value streams.

  • Methodology & Standards: Setting and enforcing best-practice methodology standards for the chapter, including process modeling (BPMN 2.0), agile requirements engineering, user story writing (Jira/Confluence), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) protocols.

  • Strategic Governance: Empowering your team to act as "The Bridge" that effectively translates business pain points into structured functional specification documents (FSDs) while strictly enforcing Fit-to-Standard and Clean Core principles to prevent unnecessary custom complexity.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering seamlessly with Business Product Owners (who prioritize the "WHAT & WHY"), SAP Consultants (The Solution), Solution Architects (The Gatekeepers), and App Engineers (The Build) to ensure a unified end-to-end delivery lifecycle.

  • Process Integrity: Ensuring your team upholds strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) guidelines and four-pillar controls during process design (e.g., keeping functional analysis strictly separated from system configuration, master data creation, and security mapping).

  • Transformation Stewardship: Driving the organizational shift from reactive project delivery toward proactive product ownership, helping the business eliminate shadow processes and friction points across boundaries like Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report.

What You Bring

You combine a deep understanding of process modeling and enterprise platforms with a consultative leadership mindset, and you enjoy empowering teams in complex transformation initiatives.

You bring:

  • Several years of experience in functional analysis, business process design, or requirements engineering within modern enterprise suites (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Salesforce, Microsoft Business Central).

  • Proven experience in a leadership or chapter lead role, with a strong passion for mentoring, team development, and resource management.

  • Deep methodological expertise in BPMN 2.0, Design Thinking, process decomposition, and defining end-to-end test scenarios.

  • Advanced tooling proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Signavio/Lucidchart/Miro, and UAT management platforms.

  • A solid understanding of core business domains such as accounting, supply chain, procurement, or digital retail.

  • Exceptional diplomatic and analytical facilitation skills; the confidence to constructively challenge business requests and guide stakeholders toward standard solutions.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working with a clear understanding of cross-system architecture boundaries.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.

  • Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.

  • Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.

  • Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.

  • Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!

  • Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Tech Lead - Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico's customers feel one pain above all: missing parts that block delivery. The Solution squads are where we turn Pelico's platform into a product that fixes it. Each squad owns one solution surface — Material Coverage & inventory, Quality, Supplier & customer Collaboration / AI Buyer, MRO & Aftermarket, Program Management, or Strategic Account Support — composing our platform's building blocks into workflows that work across many customers. You'll lead one surface end to end: ship it fast, keep it configuration-first, and feed real customer patterns back into the platform — while our Regional Solution Engineering pods carry the day-to-day customer relationship.

What You'll Do

You'll own a solution surface — and build it yourself:

  • Ship the surface. Compose configuration, compute, widgets, connectors, and agents into customer-facing workflows that pass a real acid test on real customers.

  • Stay configuration-first. Solve in Phoenix YAML wherever you can, reach for code only when it's worth it, and never let the surface fragment into per-customer forks.

  • Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and put eval and review gates on anything AI-assisted that touches a customer.

  • Harvest the field. Spot the patterns that recur across accounts and turn them into platform capabilities, so the next customer is faster.

  • Lead by example. Write the code, pair with your squad and the engineers deploying at customer sites, raise the bar, and grow the team as the impact you ship earns it.

Your impact: Customers buy outcomes — shortages caught, deliveries recovered, quality exceptions resolved. Your squad is where the platform becomes those outcomes. Own a surface well and you make Pelico's revenue engine both faster and more defensible — and you keep it from collapsing into bespoke work that can't scale.

About You

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior full-stack engineer with real product and customer judgment. You're energized by shipping outcomes under real constraints, you decide what not to build, and you lead by being in the code with your team.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing product software end to end, full-stack, under real delivery pressure

  • Strong, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (backend) and TypeScript / React (frontend); strong in one and credible across, or a fast learner

  • Product and customer judgment — scope to outcomes, cut to MVP under deadline, decide what not to build

  • A configuration-first, anti-bespoke instinct — you build for many customers, not one fork at a time

  • A track record of leading engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

Nice to have:

  • Aerospace / defense / supply-chain / discrete-manufacturing context (MRP, BoM, coverage, MRO/TAT, program management, procurement)

  • Forward-deployed / solutions-engineering / customer-embedded experience, feeding learnings back into a platform

  • Configuration- or low-code-driven product experience (YAML/DSL, composable UI, workflow authoring)

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval on AI output, spec-driven development)

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist.

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

  • Work at the frontier of applied AI, with exposure to cutting-edge AI tooling and operational challenges inside a high-growth startup

Your interview experience

  2. Hiring manager conversation with the VP Engineering (45 min)

  3. Case Study Onsite 1h30 / 2h

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. References, run in parallel

We move fast and we're transparent at every step.

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Investing App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technicien / Ingénieur Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
descriptionHtml:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) / Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.

title: Test Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. Rigorous testing is what turns a promising prototype into a product our customers can trust – and what gets us from validated prototype to Alpha customer readiness to volume shipments.

As Test Engineer, you will design and execute test plans for our power conversion systems – from functional and target-parameter verification through stability, endurance and load testing. You will build and maintain the test setups that validate our hardware and firmware, and work closely with Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical engineers to track down and resolve issues.

It is a unique opportunity to shape the test strategy of a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and execute test plans for our AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion systems – functional tests, stability tests, endurance (soak) tests, and load tests.

• Build and maintain test setups for prototype, pilot and production units, including medium-voltage test benches.

• Support prototype validation and target-parameter verification (form factor, efficiency, stability) for our Prototype milestone.

• Support qualification testing for Alpha customer deployments – full target-parameter verification, certification test support, and release tests for volume delivery.

• Develop test automation scripts and tools to increase test coverage and reduce manual test effort.

• Collaborate with the Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical teams to diagnose and root-cause test failures.

• Document test procedures, results and reports; maintain traceability for certification and quality purposes.

• Support the definition and specification of end-of-line (EOL) test equipment for volume production, working with our EOL test equipment vendor.

• Support field testing and diagnostics for units deployed at customer sites as needed.

Qualifications

• BSc / MSc in electrical engineering, electronics engineer (Elektroniker EFZ), automation engineer (Automatiker EFZ) or comparable education.

• 3+ years of experience in test engineering, ideally for power electronics or medium-voltage systems.

• Experience with medium-voltage high-power test setups and lab safety protocols and practices.

• Familiarity with test automation and scripting (e.g. Python, LabVIEW or similar).

• Understanding of power electronics test methods (efficiency, thermal, load and stability testing).

• Strong documentation and analytical skills.

• Team player, comfortable working hands-on in the lab with cross-functional teams.

• Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.

• The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Benefits

• Equity + competitive salary.

• Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.

• Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Trainee Content Creation (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Miss Germany ist kein Schönheitswettbewerb, sondern eine Plattform für Frauen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas bewegen wollen. Wir machen keinen Social-Media-Content von der Stange. Wir erzählen ihre Geschichten, Persönlichkeiten und Momente dort, wo sie gesehen werden: auf YouTube Shorts, Instagram und TikTok.

Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Short-Form nicht nur schaut, sondern versteht. Jemanden, der in den ersten zwei Sekunden eine Hook setzt, im Rhythmus schneidet und weiß, warum ein Reel durch die Decke geht – und ein anderes nicht.

Als Trainee Content Creation bei Miss Germany Studios schneidest du Short-Form-Content aus unserer YouTube-Serie und Produktionen – und aus Ideen, die du selbst mitbringst. Und wenn es passt, stehst du auch mal selbst vor der Kamera. Dabei lernst du Short-Form von Grund auf in der Praxis und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung.

Was du bei uns machst:

Schnitt: Du schneidest Shorts, Reels und TikToks – schnell, plattformgerecht und mit starken Hooks. Aus langen YouTube-Folgen, Event-Material und Behind-the-Scenes machst du Clips, die für sich allein funktionieren.

Trends & Formate: Du weißt, was auf den Plattformen gerade läuft, und bringst eigene Formatideen ein.

Vor der Kamera: Du drehst (dich) auch mal selbst.

Learnings: Du schaust dir an, was performt, und lässt das in die nächsten Videos einfließen.

Wir haben ein Match, wenn Folgendes auf dich zutrifft:

Du lebst Short-Form. Du scrollst nicht einfach – du analysierst ganz automatisch, warum dich ein Video nach zwei Sekunden hat.

Du kannst schneiden. Premiere Pro oder CapCut – Hauptsache, du bist schnell und hast ein Gefühl für Timing, Pacing und Sound.

Du bringst Social-Erfahrung mit. Idealerweise hast du schon Social-Media-Kanäle betreut oder eigenen Content veröffentlicht – für ein Unternehmen, eine Agentur oder deinen eigenen Kanal.

Du hast Creator-Energie. Du wartest nicht auf Briefings, sondern kommst mit Ideen.

Kamera ist kein Problem. Du hast keine Scheu, auch mal selbst vor der Linse zu stehen – musst aber nicht.

Du übernimmst Ownership. Du hältst Deadlines, denkst mit und gehst einen Schritt weiter, statt auf Antworten zu warten.

Du willst durchstarten. Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung abgeschlossen – idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation oder Film – oder bringst vergleichbare Erfahrung mit,
z. B. durch eigene Kanäle. Ab dem 15. Januar 2027 bist du mit 40 Stunden pro Woche dabei.

Du möchtest etwas aufbauen. Nicht verwalten, sondern gestalten.

Was wir bieten:

Build Something Big: 2027 wird Miss Germany 100 Jahre alt. Du gestaltest unseren Short-Form-Auftritt in genau dieser Phase aktiv mit.

Impact Driven: Wir unterstützen mit Herzblut Frauen bei ihrer persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung und tragen zu einer vielfältigeren und gleichberechtigteren Gesellschaft bei.

Creator Playground: Wir geben dir den Freiraum, Formate auszuprobieren und gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden, was Menschen wirklich bewegt.

Ownership statt Micromanagement: Viel Vertrauen, kurze Entscheidungswege und echte Verantwortung statt endloser Abstimmungsschleifen.

Base Köln/Düsseldorf: Du arbeitest von Köln oder Düsseldorf aus – remote oder im Co-Working-Space. Ein festes Muster gibt es nicht, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt. Für dein Onboarding sowie regelmäßige Team- und Produktionstage kommst du nach Oldenburg in unser Head Office.

Work with Inspiring People: Du arbeitest mit beeindruckenden Frauen, spannenden Persönlichkeiten, Partnern und einem Netzwerk, das weit über Miss Germany hinausgeht.

Learn Fast: Schnitt, Storytelling, Plattformen, Community, Personal Brands und Medien – du wirst in kurzer Zeit unglaublich viel lernen.

Das Traineeprogramm ist darauf ausgerichtet, dir die Methoden, Werkzeuge und fachlichen Grundlagen zu vermitteln, die du benötigst, um die Softwareentwicklung in einem hochkomplexen, hardwarenahen Umfeld effizienter zu gestalten.
Ab dem ersten Tag steht dir ein erfahrener Mentor zur Seite, der dich fachlich begleitet und individuell unterstützt. Freue dich auf ein dynamisches Team, das dich von Beginn an bei deinem Einstieg mit viel Engagement und positiver Energie unterstützt.

Unternehmensprofil

Du wirst Teil eines international führenden Unternehmens im Bereich maritimer Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitstechnologien. Als Spezialist für hochkomplexe Sensor-, Führungs- und Waffeneinsatzsysteme arbeitet das High-Tech-Unternehmen weltweit mit Marinekunden und Industriepartnern zusammen.
Mit Standorten in Deutschland und internationalen Projekten bietet das Unternehmen von Beginn an die Möglichkeit, in interdisziplinären Teams an technologisch anspruchsvollen Lösungen zu arbeiten, die sicherheitsrelevante Missionen auf See ermöglichen.
Der Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung, Integration und dem Betrieb innovativer Systeme für Unterwasser-, Überwasser- und Führungsanwendungen mit höchsten Anforderungen an Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und technologische Exzellenz.

Beschreibung der Abteilung und des Tätigkeitsbereichs

Die DevOps-Abteilung verantwortet die zentrale CI/CD-Infrastruktur und unterstützt die Softwareentwicklungsteams bei deren Nutzung und Weiterentwicklung.
Die Abteilung ist in zwei spezialisierte Bereiche gegliedert: das Core Team (Platform) und das Enablement Team (Agile DevOps).
Als Agile DevOps Engineer arbeitest du direkt im Softwareentwicklungsteam und fungierst als Brückenbauer zwischen DevOps-Methodik und der täglichen Entwicklungsarbeit. Das technische Umfeld ist hauptsächlich Embedded-geprägt mit C++ als Hauptsprache, Betriebssystemen wie Linux, sowie einer Infrastruktur im regulierten Defense-Umfeld.
Die Auswahl des konkreten Entwicklungsteams erfolgt unter Berücksichtigung deiner fachlichen Stärken, Interessen und Entwicklungsperspektiven.

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung, Support, Durchsicht, (Weiter-)Entwicklung und Überarbeitung der spezifischen CI/CD-Pipelines im Verantwortungsbereich (Projekt, Domäne, Team)
  • Unterstützung in der Testautomatisierung und Aufbau von Testpipelines
  • Durchführung der Software-Integrationsarbeit (SW|SW Integration) im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich
  • Support der Entwickler und Hilfestellung im Umgang mit DevOps-Tools und -Methoden
  • Befähigung der Entwickler zur Nutzung der Plattform und der Tools, Services und Methoden (z. B. CLion, CMake, GitLab, Gitflow)
  • Systemadministration des jeweiligen System- bzw. Produktanteils auf Basis eines definierten Workflows im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich

title: Trainee Programme
descriptionHtml:
About us
Every large organisation runs on a web of legal entities, and the data behind them is scattered across in-house teams, law firms and accountants in PDFs, spreadsheets and slide decks. Jigsaw brings it into one place.
We started by giving lawyers and accountants a faster way to model client structures, and became the category leader doing it. Today 240+ organisations use Jigsaw, including all 10 of the world’s top 10 accountancy firms. Now we’re building Entity Lifecycle Management: one live record for every entity, from formation to dissolution.
Founded by former lawyer and repeat founder Stephen Scanlan, and backed by Exor Ventures.

Why join us:
You’ll help define a new software category with the backing of a loyal, global customer base. We hire people with high ownership and a bias for action, then trust them to do their best work.

The opportunity

We're looking for three Trainees to join Jigsaw in January 2027 on a 12-month rotational programme. It's an entry-level, generalist scheme: you'll work across the three core functions of Jigsaw, Client, Build and Ops, seeing how most of the business runs, and working out where your strengths really lie.

You don't need a degree, and you don't need to have done this kind of work before. We don’t care about a polished CV, we want someone with the right attitude, energy, and a curiosity to try out a range of different roles. At the end of the year there's the potential for a permanent role.

Is this for you?

This programme is for people who don't yet know exactly what they want to do next, and see that as a reason to explore rather than a problem to fix. You might be leaving school, college or university, or returning to work after a career change and happy to start at square one.

It's not for you if you already know the career you're chasing. If you want to become a software engineer, a lawyer or a specialist in one field, a dedicated graduate or apprenticeship scheme will serve you better. Here you'll move teams every few months, switch between very different kinds of work, and won't be specialising in any one craft.

How the year works

You'll report to our COO, who has helped build several successful startups. Each rotation gives you real work to own, with people in the team to learn from along the way.

Onboarding and Product Success (first six weeks)

You'll start together as a cohort. You'll spend time with our Product Marketing team learning about the product and who our clients are, then join Product Success. There you'll see the end-to-end cycle of what we build, how clients use it and how it gets implemented, and you'll start working with clients yourself. From there, each of you moves into a different area and you rotate through the rest of the year.

Client

You'll learn how we identify what a client needs and how we pitch Jigsaw. In prospecting, you'll get to know our ideal customer profiles, reach out to and build relationships with potential clients, and report on sales results. In Customer Success, you'll support existing clients, shadow client calls, organise training sessions on behalf of a Customer Success Manager, help shape retention strategies and find ways the team can work more efficiently with AI. You may also help with marketing and social content.

Build

You’ll get involved in the day-to-day operations of how a technology company plans and manages their work. You'll see how a product gets built in an AI-native company, and how that changes the way the work is done. You'll follow the journey from an idea to the roadmap to a shipped feature.

Ops

You'll learn what it takes to scale a business of any kind. In RevOps, you'll help organise the sales tools we use, such as HubSpot and Jiminny, shape the playbook the sales team runs on, and build the content and emails we use for outreach. Across Ops, you'll develop strategic thinking, project management and commercial awareness, and may take on AI project work.

You'll thrive if

  • You'd rather explore and find the right thing than follow a set path

  • It genuinely bugs you when something isn't working as well as it could, and you want to fix it

  • You're curious, get stuck in and enjoy solving problems you haven't seen before

  • You communicate well, get on with all kinds of people and can think on your feet

  • You adapt quickly and bounce back when things don't go to plan

  • You can point to goals you've set yourself and hit, whether in study, work, sport, a hobby or a side project

  • You're low-ego, coachable and take ownership of the outcome

What you'll get

A year that gives you a genuine head start, wherever you go next:

  • A view of the whole business. Few early-career roles let you see how a growing software company wins clients, builds product and scales its operations, all in one year

  • Real work from the start. Each rotation comes with work you own and deliver, not just tasks to shadow, and you'll work directly with clients at some of the world's leading law firms and financial institutions

  • Support around you. You'll join as a cohort of three, report to our COO and have people in each team to learn from, with regular check-ins and reviews throughout each rotation

  • Skills that travel. You'll build communication, problem-solving, project management and commercial skills, and learn how an AI-native company works day to day

  • Clarity on what's next. By the end of the year you'll know where your strengths lie, with the potential to move into a permanent role at Jigsaw

What to expect

  • A video screening call: An intro call with a member of the people team to learn more about you, and what you’re looking to get out of this programme

  • A video hiring manager call: Meet with the COO who will want to understand more about your ways of working and how you tackle challenges

  • An on-site interview day: If selected, you’ll join us in our London office on November 27th. You’ll complete a group task, meet with some of our managers, and stay for Friday drinks to get to know the rest of the team

As this programme is based out of our London office, you’ll need to be able to commit to our hybrid 3-days in office arrangement, and hold full UK working rights. Unfortunately, we’re unable to provide sponsorship for this programme.
